articleTitle: Improving Biomedical Image Segmentation: An Extensive Analysis of U-Net for Enhanced Performance
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Emerging Trends in Information Technology and Engineering (ICETITE)
abstract: The U-Net architecture is the focus of this study, which optimizes biomedical picture segmentation. Improving performance in contexts with limited resources is the goal. The methodology uses GradCAM++, k-fold cross-validation, and kernel size modifications to conduct a systematic evaluation over many folds. Significant gains in accuracy, precision, recall, F1- score and accuracy are indicate in the results which reach 96.70%. By lowering the reliance on data augmentation, the suggested modifications improve the model's effectiveness. Under resource constraints, our work provides important new under- standings for biological picture segmentation.

articleTitle: Automatic Kidney Stone Detection using XResNet 152 Model for CT Images
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Emerging Trends in Information Technology and Engineering (ICETITE)
abstract: This study provides an automatic kidney stone identification using computed tomography (CT) scan images and cutting-edge deep learning techniques. The identification and categorization of diverse kidney disorders, such as stones and normal structures, are the main goals of this study. Our research intends to transform the diagnosis process by offering an accurate and effective automated system for renal health evaluation using the resilience of the XResNet152 architecture. The methodology includes a well-selected dataset with a variety of kidney diseases, which makes thorough model training, validation and assessment possible. The model used augmentation approaches and preprocessing processes specific to medical imaging data to improve its capacity to identify complex patterns and features that correspond to various kidney abnormalities. The model demonstrated remarkable precision in categorization, demonstrating encouraging outcomes in discerning and differentiating various renal ailments. The model demonstrated remarkable accuracy in distinguishing between stones and normal structures, and it demonstrated resilience in intricate medical imaging situations. In this study, we present a thorough explanation of our approach, dataset preparation, model architecture, and in-depth performance analysis. We critically assess the advantages and disadvantages of our methodology and suggest directions for further development. By advancing the field of medical image analysis, this research opens the door to more advanced precision medicine and better healthcare diagnostics.

articleTitle: Mobile Robot Multi-Objective Trajectory Planning with Velocity obstacles
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Emerging Trends in Information Technology and Engineering (ICETITE)
abstract: A velocity obstacle crossing the paths of Mobile robots is a general situation in both indoor and outdoor environments. Velocity obstacles reduce or alter the speed of the robot. The prediction of exact trajectory for the robot motion by the currently available methods is to be improved a lot. This gap is to be addressed. This manuscript proposes two multi-objective optimization methods based on evolutionary algorithms to bridge the gap. Evolutionary algorithms - Multi-objective Differential Evolution (MODE) and Elitist non-dominated sorting Genetic Algorithm (NSGA-II) are proposed in this paper. A car like mobile robot is designed, fabricated and experimented. Travel time and energy spent are considered as performance criteria in the problem solved by the proposed algorithms. Dynamic parameters' limitations, geometrical parameters' constraints and kinematic characteristics' bounds are considered in the problem. Both fixed and moving obstacles were present near the robot in its environment. So, motion of both obstacles was considered by the algorithms while planning the path of the robot. A third order NURBS function is used to characterize the mobile robot's trajectory. The optimal trajectory for the mobile robot was found by both NSGA-II and MODE. Experiments also conducted to validate the algorithms' results. Experimental validation proves that both NSGA-II and MODE are good algorithms to consider for optimal trajectory planning of mobile robots while considering stationary obstacles.

articleTitle: A Lightweight CNN for Efficient Deepfake Detection of Low-resolution Images in Frequency Domain
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Emerging Trends in Information Technology and Engineering (ICETITE)
abstract: Deepfake detection in frequency domain is extensively explored for two reasons –artifacts generated by the up-sampling layer of Generative Adversarial Networks are more prominent in the frequency domain and some image processing tasks are simpler and efficient in this domain. Traditional convolutional neural networks outperform the machine learning models for their ability to detect deepfakes of low-resolution images also. But these networks involve numerous trainable parameters resulting in huge computation cost, time and high memory requirements. This paper presents a lightweight Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) architecture that is optimized for efficient deepfake detection of low-resolution images in the frequency domain. The proposed model achieves almost the same accuracy as that of the traditional network but with the parameter requirement reduced by 92%. This renders the model suitable for use in memory-constrained and power-constrained environments such as mobile devices and other embedded systems.

articleTitle: Premature Discovery of Long-Term Prolonged Renal Disorder Using Machine Learning Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Emerging Trends in Information Technology and Engineering (ICETITE)
abstract: Prolonged Renal Disorder is a serious worldwide sickness that has an elevated illness Level and fatalities and is linked to several other ailments. Initial identification of Prolonged Renal Disorder is crucial for appropriate intervention and management because the asymptomatic character of the disease in its early stages frequently results in underdiagnosis. Healthcare practitioners may find it useful to use machine learning models' accuracy and effectiveness as a useful tool in doing this. In this work, we suggest using logistic regression to accurately diagnose renal illness that is prolonged. We investigate and contrast a number of methods, such as NB, DT, KSTAR, LOGISTIC, and SVM, in order to maximize precision. To improve the diagnostic performance, provide a novel integrated model based on perceptron. This model effectively dissects errors generated by individual models by combining the strengths of analytical techniques like logistic regression with ensemble methods like Random Forests. This framework's incorporation of increasingly intricate clinical data points to a possible direction for better disease identification. We suggest that the utilization of advanced machine learning models, when combined with a comprehensive analysis of clinical data may considerably improve the precision and dependability of the diagnosis of prolonged renal disorder. This research demonstrates how artificial intelligence may both assist ongoing attempts to improve medical technology and revolutionize healthcare practices.

articleTitle: Accuracy Analysis of Various CNN Models with Synthetic and Original Dataset for Cotton leaf
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Emerging Trends in Information Technology and Engineering (ICETITE)
abstract: In this day and age, almost in every field of work Artificial Intelligence has its part to play. Likewise in the field of agriculture, for the early detection of diseases Artificial Intelligence algorithms were used. These algorithms use image classification models to perform this operation. So, to get better result in the early disease detection these models need to be trained with a balance dataset with huge of number of training samples. But finding a balanced dataset is quite impossible so in this manuscript we created a fresh dataset for cotton leaf by combining the images from the original and synthetic dataset. For that first we generated the synthetic dataset for cotton leaf using Deep Convolutional Generative Adversarial Network(DCGAN)algorithm which generates the artificial images like the images present in the original dataset. Then Convolutional Neural Network models like: Inception V3, Visual Geometry Group(VGG) 16, Residual Network(ResNet) 50 and MobileNet V2 are used to implement the accuracy analysis for the original dataset and newly created dataset to show that newly created dataset with synthetic images provides better accuracy rate when compared with the original dataset.

articleTitle: Blockchain Powered Integrated Health Profile and Record Management System for Seamless Consultation Leveraging Unique Identifiers
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Emerging Trends in Information Technology and Engineering (ICETITE)
abstract: The Integrated Health Profile (IHP) leverages blockchain technology and smart contracts to establish a decentralized and tamper-resistant platform for the storage and sharing of decentralized health records (DHRs). Secured remote access to doctor-patient data is the need of the hour as the world moves towards home-based online services. In the IHP, each patient is assigned a unique identifier, and their health records are securely stored and linked to this identifier. The implementation of an individualized IHP card is the center of the IHP framework, which serves as a comprehensive repository for a patient's health records, including reports, prescriptions, medical bills, and insurance receipts. The IHP card is equipped with a unique QR code linked to the patient's unique identifier (UID). When scanned by a medical practitioner, the patient receives a one-time password (OTP) via a two-factor authentication process, providing an additional layer of consent and security. Upon successful verification, the doctor gains access to a specific subset of the patient's shared records, ensuring the patient's privacy is respected. The IHP framework significantly streamlines the customer intake process, eliminating the need for manual data entry at healthcare facility receptions. This reduction in administrative tasks minimizes waiting times and improves overall operational efficiency. Furthermore, by integrating the customer's medical history with the IHP card, medical service providers gain comprehensive insights into the customer's health status, facilitating accurate diagnoses and personalized treatment plans. To enable efficient healthcare service discovery, the IHP framework utilizes standardized application programming interfaces (APIs) to connect customer-centric applications (CCAs) with medical service provider applications (MSPs). Through these APIs, CCAs can access real-time information on available healthcare facilities, ensuring customers receive accurate and up-to-date details regarding their healthcare options.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of PV-Fed BLDC Motor for Irrigation Scheme
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Emerging Trends in Information Technology and Engineering (ICETITE)
abstract: Due to the increasing demand for electricity and the limited availability of conventional energy resources, solar Photo Voltaic (PV) energy has emerged as a promising alternative. It offers several advantages, including being environmentally friendly, easily accessible, and cost-effective to maintain. This paper presents the design of an irrigation system powered by a solar PV array, employing a zeta converter to efficiently harness power from the PV array as an intermediate DC-DC converter. The primary objective of this study is to simulate a water pumping system utilizing a solar PV array, a zeta converter for optimal power extraction, and a Voltage Source Inverter (VSI) to drive a BLDC motor. The Zeta converter is controlled using the Incremental Conductance (INC) MPPT technique, while the VSI employs electrical commutation logic for fundamental frequency switching of the BLDC motor. Importantly, the proposed irrigation system is designed to maintain functionality when confronted with dynamic conditions, and this paper discusses both the MATLAB simulation results and hardware development aspects of the system.

articleTitle: Super Resolution of Medical Images Using SRGAN
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Emerging Trends in Information Technology and Engineering (ICETITE)
abstract: Medical imaging is essential for precise diagnosis and treatment planning in contemporary healthcare, yet getting high-resolution pictures can be difficult because of things like low-dose CT scans' reduced radiation exposure. In order to tackle this problem, a unique strategy called Super-Resolution Generative Adversarial Networks (SRGAN) is presented in this research. To improve image resolution, SRGAN uses a generator and discriminator architecture with residual and upscale blocks. By combining adversarial and content losses, the generator's loss function enables it to produce high-quality images while keeping key elements of their low-resolution counterparts. A thorough literature study demonstrates how effective GAN-based models are for the super-resolution of medical images. After 10 training epochs, experimental findings utilizing a Lung CT dataset show a significant improvement, with PSNR and SSIM scores reaching 32.95 and 0.996, respectively. According to these findings, SRGANs are a viable enhancement technique for low-dose CT medical pictures, with significant advantages for precise diagnosis and patient care in healthcare settings.

articleTitle: Experimental Characterization of Atmospheric-Pressure Plasma Using Langmuir Probe Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Emerging Trends in Information Technology and Engineering (ICETITE)
abstract: Langmuir probe diagnosis of a Cold Atmospheric Plasma (CAP) jet requires inserting the probe directly into the downstream zone, which causes extra filament discharges and thereby changes the plasma properties. In this work, we present a technique to sample the CAP jet into a low pressure chamber via an aperture for Langmuir probe diagnosis. Since the extracted sample carries very low current, multiple probe designs have been tested to get a proper I-V curve. The Langmuir probe theory for collisional plasmas was used, which is based on bulk flow velocity and sheath thickness. The plasma density and temperature are estimated to be. × / and 3.1 eV respectively, for the operating condition of 1W at 12 kHz, with very low argon flow rate.

articleTitle: AI-powered Hygiene Hub: A Multifaceted Approach to Public Health in High-Traffic Areas
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Emerging Trends in Information Technology and Engineering (ICETITE)
abstract: In all kinds of pandemic situations, managing the crowd is a big challenge. Managing the crowd will control the disease spreading. This paper aims to develop an integrated system using Raspberry Pi and Arduino that performs automatic hand sanitization for cleaning, mask, and temperature detection for prevention and identification of symptoms respectively. These actions will be conducted in an organized environment that maintains the required distance between two individuals to avoid infections. The accessories carried by the individual will be disinfected by UV lights fitted in the Conveyor.

articleTitle: Comparative Study on the Performance of Microstrip Patch Antenna using Gold, Silver, and Copper as Radiating Surfaces
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Emerging Trends in Information Technology and Engineering (ICETITE)
abstract: An analysis was conducted to evaluate the performance of an inset-fed microstrip patch antenna with different radiating surfaces. Substrate, Rogers RT/Duroid 5880 was used in the design, along with patch metals gold, silver, and copper. The gold patch material produced a return loss of −58.757 dB, a VSWR value of 1.002 at 27.01 GHz, and the highest bandwidth of 4.789 GHz at 26.891 GHz. During the measurements, the silver patch exhibited the highest bandwidth of 4.78 GHz. Copper, on the other hand, resulted in a return loss of −45.436 dB, a VSWR value of 1.01, and a bandwidth of 4.756 GHz. These results indicate that the antenna is well-matched to the gold radiating surface-based system and the impedance is properly tuned, showing the positive impact of our design for next-generation wireless applications.

articleTitle: A Compact High Gain Millimeter Wave Circular Fractal Antenna Design for Next-Generation Wireless Communications
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Emerging Trends in Information Technology and Engineering (ICETITE)
abstract: This paper proposes a Taconic-based 28.25GHz Circular Microstrip Patch Antenna designed and fabricated for high-frequency applications. An extensive comparison has been made between five materials such as Rogers, Taconic, FR4, Quartz, PTFE, and Rogers which can possibly be used in the design of 28GHz band antennas. Out of these materials, Taconic material came out to give better results. Due to the increasing demand for improved antenna performance, gain, and other linear characteristics, the microstrip antenna has been improved by the addition of fractals. Since it has a compact size (10mm x 10mm) and higher efficiency, it can be used for 5G applications.

articleTitle: Neptune - An Integrated Social Media Platform
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Emerging Trends in Information Technology and Engineering (ICETITE)
abstract: This conference paper looks at the pervasive influence of social media on different aspects of our lives and examines four different areas. The first area focuses on realtime detection of events in social media and addresses the challenges posed by informal language and acronyms. The second area, web development, looks at the transformative power of frameworks such as Django in creating feature-rich web applications. The third section looks at analyzing mental health in social media and highlights the need for comprehensive research on English-speaking users. Finally, privacy in social media is critically examined, highlighting the importance of raising aware-ness and implementing best practice. This comprehensive study provides valuable insights for navigating the evolving landscape of online interactions.

articleTitle: Network Intrusion Detection Using Multi-Modal Ensemble Modeling
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Emerging Trends in Information Technology and Engineering (ICETITE)
abstract: In recent times, networks and related data have greatly increased because of quick developments in the internet and communication domains. As a result, we witness a surge of new verities of security threats, which has made it difficult for network security professionals to identify breaches and mitigate them promptly. Moreover, it is impossible to overlook the existence of hackers who intend to carry out different types of assaults on the network. One such technology is an intrusion detection system (IDS), which guards against potential network invasions by examining network traffic to guarantee its availability, confidentiality, and integrity. There have been several works in this regard where we have advanced from traditional tools to Machine learning-based techniques. In this paper, we demonstrate the strength of ensemble modelling using a linear weighted combination of XGBoost and CNN. We specifically aim at utilizing network logs in both their tabular form (with XGBoost) as well as in the form of images (with CNN) for utilizing the data to its full potential. We compare our performance with existing benchmarks and observe that our proposed method outperforms them. Our proposed method achieves a high Recall and Precision, with an overall F1-score of 0.995.

articleTitle: A Comparative Study of Different Segmentation and Regression Models for Fetal Head Circumference Measurement
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Emerging Trends in Information Technology and Engineering (ICETITE)
abstract: Constant fetal health monitoring during pregnancy becomes crucial in assessing and diagnosing natural fetal growth. Out of all the methods, the ultrasound imaging-based approach for fetal aspect measurement is quite commonly used in modern days. An extensive comparative approach of various regression and segmentation models has been taken in this paper in the measurement of fetal head circumference. This research focuses on optimal model selection out of CNN regression models and segmentation models. Out-of-regression CNN models ResNet-50, InceptionV3, EfficientNet, and out-of-segmentation models U- net and Attention-Unet have been considered and implemented. Utilizing evaluation matrices such as MAE, RMSE, accuracy, and standard deviation for comparative analysis, the model designs were examined. This research work was carried out on the public dataset named HC-18 containing 805 multi-scaled ultrasound images. With room for improvement in this research work, it is highly evident that Inception V3 performed the best having an accuracy of about 87.04% whereas U-net performed the worst, having an accuracy of about 73.85%.

articleTitle: Development of a Novel Three-Axis Force Sensor-Based Monitoring Device for Static Shoulder Therapy
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Emerging Trends in Information Technology and Engineering (ICETITE)
abstract: Static shoulder rehabilitation exercises are performed by stroke patients suffering from shoulder subluxation, which requires pushing the hand against a rigid surface by maintaining the elbow joint at a fixed position. This method, when carried out by patients at home in the absence of a physiotherapist, can overstrain the muscles. To overcome this problem, a compact and cost-effective tabletop monitoring device for static shoulder therapy is presented in this paper. It can be used for rehabilitation applications like strength and neural function recovery of the shoulder muscles, reducing shoulder subluxation in stroke patients, etc. This device is a rigid structure that utilizes a 3D printed three-axis force sensor to which a palm rest is attached for providing force feedback when the static force is applied by the user. This paper also presents the design of the three-axis force sensor along with system mechatronics design and calibration. The device is then tested by incorporating it with a simple game interface to carry out a game-based rehabilitation exercise.

articleTitle: PySpark Gender Inference: Distributed Machine Learning Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Emerging Trends in Information Technology and Engineering (ICETITE)
abstract: Gender classification is a fundamental task in various applications, such as marketing, healthcare, and social sciences, where understanding demographic patterns is crucial. A scalable solution like PySpark is required to process and analyze massive amounts of gender-related data in a proper and efficient manner because traditional methods frequently cannot handle the scope of modern datasets. The gender categorization procedure is parallelized using the suggested methodology, which takes advantage of PySpark's distributed computing capabilities to enable quicker and more effective model training and performance assessment. Robust gender categorization models are developed by the study using algorithms of machine learning, like random forests, decision trees, and logistic regression. The study assesses the performance and scalability of the PySpark-based gender categorization models on different datasets. It also highlights how well they handle large amounts of data. The tests show that PySpark has the ability to improve gender classification tasks speed, precision, accuracy, especially when working with big datasets. The results underline PySpark's function as an effective tool for gender categorization tasks in the age of enormous datasets, adding to the expanding body of knowledge in big data analytics and machine learning.

articleTitle: Forecasting GDP Per Capita Using Machine Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Emerging Trends in Information Technology and Engineering (ICETITE)
abstract: Traditional GDP per capita calculations were based on simplistic models, often relying solely on population figures as the primary determinant. However, as our understanding of economics and data analysis has evolved, we have come to recognize that a multitude of socio-economic and demographic factors significantly influence a nation's economic well-being. This limitation leads to imprecise predictions and hampers the ability to make data-driven policy decisions and strategically plan economic development. In response to this challenge, we propose a pioneering approach that harnesses the capabilities of Machine Learning (ML) to model these intricate and non-linear relationships, significant improving the accuracy of GDP per capita forecasting. Within our framework, we have taken into account factors such as population, area, population density, coastline, net migration, literacy, phones, infant mortality, arable land, crop land, other land, birth rate, death rate, region, and climate to compute the GDP per capita of the country. Our study involves a comprehensive comparative analysis of two robust ML models, Random Forest and Neural Network regression. These models excel in handling complex data relationships, uncovering nuanced patterns, and effectively mitigating common issues like overfitting. By systematically assessing the performance of these models, we utilize critical metrics, including Mean Squared Error (MSE), Mean Absolute Error (MAE), and R-squared (R^2) score. The insights gained from this comparative analysis are invaluable for policymakers, economists, and researchers, as they facilitate more informed and evidence-based policy decisions, optimize resource allocation, and enhance economic planning.

articleTitle: Enhanced Tea Leaf Disease Detection using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Emerging Trends in Information Technology and Engineering (ICETITE)
abstract: In this article, a novel method based on transfer learning and sophisticated deep learning techniques is presented for the detection of illnesses in tea leaves using a convolutional neural network (CNN). Leveraging the Kaggle Tea Illness Dataset, the retrained CNN model achieves an impressive 92% accuracy in classifying various tea leaf diseases, surpassing traditional methods. Employing the lightweight deep neural network NASNet further improves accuracy to almost 95.90%, outperforming existing literature and showcasing its effectiveness in precise disease classification. This method represents a significant advancement in plant pathology, demonstrating the potential for broader applications in environmental and agricultural monitoring.

articleTitle: Tapered-Based Novel Thermal Compensation Techniques for Enhanced Performance of MEMS-Based Gyroscope
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Emerging Trends in Information Technology and Engineering (ICETITE)
abstract: Understanding and mitigating the impact of temperature on MEMS-based gyroscope performance is crucial for their reliable use in various applications including defence, navigation, robotics, and aerospace systems. This paper analyses the effect of the temperature change and proposes a new compensation idea for the temperature-induced change at the structure design level. As the temperature varies from low to high temperatures, the drive and sense frequency mismatch is observed. It is important to minimize the frequency mismatch because it has a strong influence on bandwidth and sensitivity. The design innovations of the beam structure of sense mass are used to control the frequency mismatch and the deformation due to temperature variation. It is proposed that using a tapered beam for the sense deflection, the frequency mismatch is reduced in the full temperature range, and mechanical sensitivity variation is also reduced. The new design innovation holds promise for future applications requiring more temperature-tolerant MEMS gyroscope sensors.

articleTitle: Performance Comparison and Analysis of Machine Learning and Deep Learning Models for Network Intrusion Detection In IoT-Edge Frameworks
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Emerging Trends in Information Technology and Engineering (ICETITE)
abstract: The Internet of Things (IoT) has fundamentally changed the approach of technology utilization in day-to-day life. With a drastic increase in the use of sensors, a huge volume of data is generated, and it becomes cumbersome for central repositories to handle it. To address this issue, an edge device layer is introduced in IoT to lessen cloud computing and storage load by exploiting the resources close to the data source. However, this infrastructure added various security concerns. Therefore, detecting intrusions in IoT edge devices became a primary goal. Recent advancements in intrusion detection in IoT Edge require Machine learning (ML) and deep learning (DL) algorithms to identify the intrusions. The effectiveness of ML/DL models for intrusion detection in IoT edge devices is shown in this paper. Three prominent threats are identified for intrusion detection. The outcomes of various algorithms are compared using different performance metrics and analyzed for their applicability in IoT edge devices.

articleTitle: Firefly Algorithm with Deep Belief Network for Crop Classification Model in Agricultural Sector
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Emerging Trends in Information Technology and Engineering (ICETITE)
abstract: Data mining (DM) is an effective way to extract essential and meaningful data to determine patterns from a large dataset. Data mining finds its applications in diverse areas of healthcare, agriculture, transport, e-commerce, etc. In the agricultural sector, the recently developed DM and machine learning (ML) methods can be leveraged for effective decision-making. Crop classification is the process employed to properly categorize various kinds of crops in an automated and timely way. At the same time, hyperparameters perform a decisive role in affecting the overall classification performance of the deep learning (DL) models. Therefore, this study develops an optimal deep belief network (OPTDBN) approach for crop classification in the agricultural sector. The proposed OPTDBN model intends to properly classify distinct types of crops that exist in the agricultural data. To attain this, the OPTDBN model performs an effective classification process using the DBN model. To enhance the performance of the DBN based predictive technique, the firefly (FF) algorithm is utilized and it results in enhanced classification results. The application of the FF algorithm assists in optimal hyperparameter selection of the DBN model. To exhibit the superior outcomes of the OPTDBN methodology, a sequence of simulations were effectuated and the outcomes are reviewed under soybeans and mushroom datasets. The simulation outcomes stated the enhanced performance of the OPTDBN methodology than the other current approaches interms of different measures.

articleTitle: AI Based Talking and Virtual Eye for Visionless People
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Emerging Trends in Information Technology and Engineering (ICETITE)
abstract: The emerging growth in communication technology, created a path for innovation of various consumer products that support peoples in different arena. The problem faced by visually impaired people on communicating the emotions, actual intention clearly to the people on other side, is solved by the innovative virtual modules developed. A comprehensive study on AI based talking and virtual eye and its benefits are discussed over here. Various automotive devices are evolving recently to assist visual impairment peoples. Android application based guiding system; GPS enabled smart navigational systems are one of those developments. It is considered as one of the social responses to support visually impaired peoples and helping them for survival. The existing state of art approaches considers the critical challenges behind the scenario and evaluated various innovations using embedded systems technology and artificial intelligence systems. Considering all aspects of problems, in terms of cost, reliability, the flexibility in usage, the exploration of products focused on keen feature analysis through cognitive approach. All these steps are keeping a supportive hand to the visually impaired peoples.

articleTitle: An Efficient U-Net based Model for Low Grade Glioma Segmentation in MRI Images
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Emerging Trends in Information Technology and Engineering (ICETITE)
abstract: Low-grade gliomas (LGG) are brain tumors that grow slowly and originate from glial cells. Detecting these tumors at an early stage is crucial, and Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) serves as an effective screening method for this purpose. Precise identification of tumor borders in MRI images is crucial for effective treatment planning. This study employs an efficient U-net based model for segmenting brain tumors in Magnetic Resonance images. Through meticulous data pre-processing and augmentation techniques, the proposed model is trained to accurately delineate intricate tumor boundaries. The model's performance was evaluated using the Intersection Over Union (IoU) and Dice coefficient metrics on a publicly available Low- Grade Glioma (LGG) segmentation dataset. Experimentation with various backbone architectures reveals that employing ResNet-50 outperforms VGG16 and VGG19. Furthermore, com- parison with state-of-the-art methods shows that the proposed model surpasses existing works in LGG segmentation.

articleTitle: Deep Learning and Machine Learning Algorithms to Predict Lung Cancer
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Emerging Trends in Information Technology and Engineering (ICETITE)
abstract: Lung cancer is the most deadly illness for patients, and it is an incurable condition. Patient survival rates are greatly increased by early cancer prognosis and identification. The Computed Tomography (CT) scan is an important imaging tool for a lung cancer diagnosis. On the other hand, a manual CT scan inspection is laborious and prone to mistakes. Lung cancer can be impulsively recognized by utilizing an image processing technique of Computer-Aided Diagnosis (CAD). In recent years, various researchers identified various ways for accurate prediction by Using techniques for deep learning (DL) and machine learning (ML). This research represents a number of methodologies like Lung cancer disease prediction analysis makes use of Artificial Neural Network (ANN), Logistic Regression (LR), Support Vector Machine (SVM), K-means clustering, Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) Recurrent Neural Network (RNN) and Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM).

articleTitle: Reinforcement Learning-Based Smart Bidding Strategy in Electricity Market for Effective Distributed Consumer Participation
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Emerging Trends in Information Technology and Engineering (ICETITE)
abstract: Distribution operators can change consumer usage patterns through a variety of demand-side management strategies, thanks to smart grid technology. This entails the utility and the customers working together to modify customer loads in a way that benefits the stakeholders in various sectors. The main challenge posed by system operators nowadays is creating simulations of the system market systems that effectively choose generation resources under changing load patterns. An agent-based bidding technique for markets is presented in this article and implemented for a five-bus grid. The real power load model is created to enable connections to load buses from various load profile types, including commercial, industrial, and residential. A comprehensive DC OPF model serves as the basis for the Locational Marginal Prices (LMPs) and using Reinforcement Learning, GenCos proactively modify their supply offers over time. Two scenarios are compared relating the features of the day-ahead market: one in which the load is connected as a single, homogenous entity, and the other in which it is segmented into various client kinds.

articleTitle: Personality Identification Based on Handwritten Signature
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Emerging Trends in Information Technology and Engineering (ICETITE)
abstract: A individual has specific characteristics that form a unique personality that distinguishes that inividual from others and reflects the indivual's character and behavior when dealing with the environment. Graphology is the science of personality analysis based on hand-writing. Graphology expresses handwriting as a person's fingerprint in a written form. The signature is a mixture of writing and drawing and contains many indicators of an individual's charateristics. This paper addresses the challenge of a limited dataset in the field of graphology by collecting Arabic and English handwritten signature samples from students at King Abdulaziz University. Leveraging deep learning techniques, we extract signature indications from this diverse dataset, employing both single-label and multi-label classification approaches. The results demonstrate that single-label classification achieves 95% accuracy using ResNet and 91% using VGG16. Additionally, a custom convolutional neural network (CNN) was utilized, yielding an accuracy of 88%. In the case of multi-label classification, VGG16 and ResNet achieved an accuracy of 85%, while the EfficientNet model reached 86%.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence and Big Data Based Algorithm to Track Child Abduction and Child Trafficking Patterns Using Sensors
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Emerging Trends in Information Technology and Engineering (ICETITE)
abstract: Preventing child abduction is another example of application of Artificial Intelligence, sensors and GNSS. Some of the common crimes against abducted children are already known by mainstream media. AI, GNSS and sensors have shown a potential solution to this problem. GNSS chips are as small as 3 millimeters. Their power consumption is so low that even a solar charger smaller than the smallest nail on human hand can power them. In conclusion, such a device can be easily implemented and hidden with child accessories. It makes it difficult for the kidnapper to detect them. It also ensures speedy and timely delivery of justice for the victim. Different sensors make it easy for the device to detect kidnapping at an early stage. Experiments were done with different sensors in 3D. Various possibilities of power source were also studied. Artificial Intelligence was used to figure out a common pattern related to time, location, vehicle, and transportation of the victims. This data can help to reunite families with their abducted children. Yes, big data was also employed to discover a pattern in child abduction and child trafficking. Comparison was made with already existing technologies.

articleTitle: Visualizing Healing Image Analysis of Gangrene from DFU Progression
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Emerging Trends in Information Technology and Engineering (ICETITE)
abstract: An open sore or crack on the foot of a person with diabetes is known as a diabetic foot ulcer. These ulcers could develop, inflame, and heal. Gangrene is an imminent threat that is exacerbated by an inadequate blood supply. This work develops a robust method for discerning and screening gangrene in medical images linked to diabetic foot ulcers by utilizing deep learning techniques and upscale image processing techniques. CNN is a deep learning architecture that is widely recognized for its effectiveness in image identification tasks. This is especially crucial when working with medical imaging, as patterns can differ. The objective of the generated system is to recognize the gangrene from DFU images using the versions of convolutional deep learning networks including VGG16(Visual Geometric Group), VGG19, and ResNet50.

articleTitle: Parallel Convolutional Neural Network for Brain Tumor Using MR Images
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Emerging Trends in Information Technology and Engineering (ICETITE)
abstract: We propose a method that utilizes an Auto-Context Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) to learn important local and global image features from 2D patches of varying window sizes. Brain imaging is a crucial first step in many neuroimaging techniques. The precision and efficiency of brain extraction are important to the overall accuracy. Brain extraction algorithms rely on brain atlases that combine questions about anatomy and assume geometry. However, when these assumptions are violated, the effectiveness of this process is limited. As a result, this study presents a CNN-based automated technique for developing an accurate brain extraction tool. We use two different methods to learn local and global images from two dimension patches: 1) Three parallel 2D convolutions based on three different dimensions (axial, coronal and sagittal). This uses a voxel method of implicitly learning 3D data without computationally expensive 3D convolution. 2 U-net architecture-based advanced convolutional network. We employ network post-processing outputs as interactive data, together with raw pictures, to extract local images and brain connections from non-brain tissue. The study proposes a new model for NLM filtering of MRI images. The proposed technique was tested MRI data. We have achieved outstanding results in brain extraction with our CNN algorithm. It has demonstrated better performance than two recently released public reference sets, LPBA40 and OASIS, with Dice overlap coefficients. Our automated content algorithms have enabled us to make significant improvements. We have also evaluated our algorithm's performance in extracting fetal brains from reconstructed MRI datasets with arbitrary orientation Our CNN surpasses previous approaches in extracting fetal brains from MRI. Our algorithm has achieved a Dice coefficient of 95.97%. Iteratively using posterior probability maps and image patches to extract the brain from non-brain tissue.

articleTitle: Diagnosis of Diabetic Retinopathy Via Classification of Fundus Images Using Deep Learning Methods
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Emerging Trends in Information Technology and Engineering (ICETITE)
abstract: In diabetics, a condition known as diabetic retinopathy (DR) can harm the retina is a tissue located at the rear of the eye that contains blood vessels., resulting in vision loss or possibly blindness. It often affects both eyes, is more common in people who have had diabetes mellitus for a longer period of time. Early detection and appropriate treatment can help to control diabetic retinopathy, but once it has progressed past a certain point, there is no cure and no way to stop it. Thorough dilated eye exam, a labour - intensive manual procedure requiring a qualified ophthalmologist and a significant investment of time and money, is used to diagnose dry eye disease. Consequently, we are able to automatically identify various stages of diabetic retinopathy using the Fundus image with the help of convolutional neural network. In order to categorise the severity stages of diabetic retinopathy, which range from 0 (No diabetic retinopathy) to 4 (Proliferative diabetic retinopathy), we present Deep Transfer Learning classification technique utilising convolutional neural network trained model. A user interface must be made first. The second stage is to use filtering and pre-processing procedures to get rid of the extraneous elements from the image. Applying an appropriate algorithm that can identify the image and determine the degree of diabetic retinopathy severity is the third stage. The fundus image's severity degree and a detailed explanation of the presence stage are shown.

articleTitle: Prediction of Osteosarcoma Using Binary Convolutional Neural Network: A Machine Learning Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Emerging Trends in Information Technology and Engineering (ICETITE)
abstract: This study explores the use of Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) for predicting osteosarcoma, a challenging bone cancer. Leveraging CNN's efficacy in medical image analysis, the research develops a specialized prediction model. The dataset, featuring diverse raw images from various medical imaging techniques, ensures a representative case spectrum. Pre-processing techniques like resizing, normalization, and augmentation optimize the dataset for effective CNN training. Through systematic partitioning into training and testing sets, the study comprehensively evaluates the CNN model's performance in osteosarcoma prediction. This research contributes valuable insights into CNN's role in bone cancer prediction, highlighting its effectiveness in navigating the complexities of osteosarcoma detection, thereby advancing accuracy in medical diagnoses.

articleTitle: Detecting Fuel Theft with Arduino
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Emerging Trends in Information Technology and Engineering (ICETITE)
abstract: To address the common fuel-related problems in parking lots, especially in those without security or CCTV, we introduce a Fuel Monitoring System that makes use of the embedded system technology. With its realtime fuel level monitoring, this proactive solution seeks to solve worries about fuel theft. In the event that fuel theft occurs, the system's embedded Global Communications Technology (GSM) allows for seamless communication and prompt text message notification of vehicle owners. Our design places a high value on cost-effectiveness and simplicity while also showcasing technological innovation. Microcontroller integration transforms the system into an advanced, user-friendly way to improve vehicle security in a variety of parking situations.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of DP-64-QAM Optical Networks Using Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Emerging Trends in Information Technology and Engineering (ICETITE)
abstract: This study discusses a convolutional neural network established perturbative nonlinearity compensation that represents two channels with first-order perturbation theory that builds a classifier as well as a regressor. We need to represent the convolutional neural network equalizer in 370 kilometer 120-Gb/s dual-polarization 64-quadrature-amplitude modulation fiber-optic networks. Also, well defined the nonlinear activation function for convolutional neural network equalizer. This research work calculates the bit error rate and launched optical signals. If the channel size is 10, the bit error rate performance for the convolutional neural network classifier is 0.0011 (1 dBm) and the convolutional neural network regressor is 0.0018 (0 dBm). The bit-error ratio is fewer than 6%, and a threshold value is 0.0037 (−3 dBm to 3 dBm). If the channel size is 14, the bit-error-ratio (−4 dBm, 4 dBm, and 5 dBm) is fewer than 0.0018. We are required to analyze different network complexity by using convolutional neural network classifiers with regressors. We need to simulate the time complexity up to 24.99%, and the space complexity is 49.99%.

articleTitle: Deep Learning-Based Fire and Smoke Detection System
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Emerging Trends in Information Technology and Engineering (ICETITE)
abstract: This paper presents a novel Deep Learning-Based Fire and Smoke Detection System designed to surpass conventional sensor-dependent methods. Unlike traditional fire detection systems reliant on sensors, this system utilizes computer vision techniques and deep learning algorithms, specifically convolutional neural networks, to analyze video footage and images for the presence of fire or smoke. The proposed system addresses the limitations of sensor-based approaches, making it particularly suitable for extensive environments like large forested areas or open spaces where sensor deployment is impractical. By leveraging the power of deep learning, the system enhances the accuracy and efficiency of fire and smoke detection, enabling it to adapt to complex real-world scenarios. The core objective is to reduce the frequency and severity of fire accidents. Upon detecting fire or smoke in a monitored area, the system triggers immediate notifications via email to the relevant user and activates a fire alarm. This comprehensive approach enhances the capabilities of video surveillance systems in forest settings and contributes to a more proactive and responsive fire prevention strategy.

articleTitle: Scalable Modular Battery Management System Using Model-Based Approach for EV Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Emerging Trends in Information Technology and Engineering (ICETITE)
abstract: The global automotive industry is in the phase where Internal Combustion vehicles are in decline and witnessing a shift towards sustainable development. The major parameter of a successful EV is an efficient battery pack and the protection for it which is the Battery management system (BMS). In this work model-based approach in the design of a Modular Battery Management System (BMS) takes into account various protection schemes such as over and under-voltage scenarios adopted in Li-ion batteries and monitoring the State of Charge (SoC) using the Coulomb Counting technique. The design and the simulation-based approach are adopted to study the behaviour of Li-ion Battery and BMS in a wide operational condition where the testing is difficult using MATLAB/Simulink. The proposed technique is a Modular Battery Management System that works on the Master-Slave Architecture.

articleTitle: Max-Min Fairness of mm-Wave Communication Using Multi-Beam Beamspace MIMO-NOMA
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Emerging Trends in Information Technology and Engineering (ICETITE)
abstract: In order to increase the number of connections, a non-orthogonal multiple access (NOMA) scheme is taken into consideration in this study for mmwave multi-beam transmissions across beamspace (BS-MIMO) channels. We examine the maximized-minimal(max-min) rate of the beamspace MIMO-NOMA (BS-MIMO-NOMA) system according to power allocation in order to increase the throughput while retaining fairness of user. The difficulty is that non-convexity in the power allocation issue due to both inter-beam and intra-beam interference and takes a tough task to solve. To solve this problem, we address an iterative algorithm to figure out maximum-minimum rate and associated power allocation. We maximize and analyse the minimal rate of the BS-MIMO-NOMA in a conventional mmWave channel model to ensure the achievable sumrate of the proposed beamspace scheme. We show that when all users are given the same rate, the improved max-min rate (MMR) is achieved. For achieving the dynamic power allocation, a closed-form solution is developed by taking the Karush-Kuhn-Tucker (KKT) criteria into consideration. The proposed BS-MIMO-NOMA performs better than the existing orthogonal multiple access (OMA) techniques in terms of minimal rate, based on outcomes of the simulation.

articleTitle: Performance Enhancement of NOMA for Emerging Wireless Networks Using SIC Repeaters
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Emerging Trends in Information Technology and Engineering (ICETITE)
abstract: Non-Orthogonal Multiple Access (NOMA) is an emerging wireless technology and serves as a valuable competitor to its orthogonal counterpart, Orthogonal Multiple Access. The use of NOMA however creates a need for the users to have knowledge about other user signals in order to obtain their own signals. This leaves out a significant security threat where in a malicious node can gain access to the network by simply attacking a node in that area. In the proposed work, we have developed a novel scheme to counter this security gap by performing successive interference cancellation (SIC) at a smart repeater and not by the users. The study shows that implementing this methodology not only improves the overall security of the network but also enhances the data rates of the users. Furthermore, page rank algorithm is utilized allocation of energy coefficients to users in order to maximize. Comprehensive simulations validates the advantages and the potency of the proposed methodology.

articleTitle: Violent Behaviour Analysis in Crowd
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Emerging Trends in Information Technology and Engineering (ICETITE)
abstract: In response to the increasing demand in crowd management, and to solve the challenges of categorizing crowds as violent and non-violent, we have introduced a new architecture called Violent Behaviour Analysis (VBA). The VBA architecture combines the Congested Scene Recognition Network (CSRNet) and the Unet, CSRNet consists of a data acquisition module in the foreground and a processing unit in the background. The data acquisition module captures intricate crowd-related details and the processing unit performs the generation of a density map for precise spatial representation. The Unet along with CSRNet estimates density maps and also distinguishes crowd regions from their backgrounds to improve accuracy. The architecture is evaluated using a video dataset known as the Violent dataset built from an image dataset of fine-grain crowd-counting. The results with density maps and CMAE demonstrate the efficiency of this approach in categorizing the crowd as violent and violent individuals.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Based Dent Damage Detection Using Image Processing Methods
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Emerging Trends in Information Technology and Engineering (ICETITE)
abstract: Finding cracks and dents in pressed panel goods is a crucial step in assessing their quality. This study presents a novel edge line evaluation method for non-invasive crack detection based on obtaining the captured object's outline. The objective of this proposed work is to use convolutional neural network (CNN) algorithm to develop an automated system that can accurately recognize dents on cars or other metal surfaces. The suggested system uses YOLO V3, R-CNN algorithms, and image processing approaches to find dents or fissures in metal or concrete surfaces. A competitive edge should prioritize improved accuracy, quicker dent detection, wider applicability, and cost-effectiveness.

articleTitle: Design of Enhanced CNN Model for Rice Disease Classification with Comparative Analysis on Different Variants of Dataset
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Emerging Trends in Information Technology and Engineering (ICETITE)
abstract: Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) is extensively employed in crop disease classification and has been achieving remarkable results. But the challenge researchers face while designing the CNN model is misclassification of diseases leading to low accuracy and huge training time. Overfitting is the common problem which is faced by CNN models. Also, the dataset used is the key factor for training the CNN model. This study proposes the CNN architecture for rice disease identification with enhanced accuracy and less training time. Three convolutional layers and two dense layer are added along with application of max pooling, batch normalization and dropout layers. Hyperparameter fine tuning is applied for training the proposed architecture to obtain the optimized parameters to improve the model accuracy. The proposed CNN model is evaluated by doing comparative analysis on three variants of rice disease dataset which includes RGB images, grey scale images and augmented RGB images. It has been found in the study that proposed CNN architecture performs classification of rice diseases with high accuracy and without overfitting on all three variants of dataset dataset. It attains best training accuracy of 96.75% and testing accuracy of 95.25% with augmented RGB images with training time of 127 seconds only.

articleTitle: Automated Kidney Stone Detection using Deep Learning Technique
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Emerging Trends in Information Technology and Engineering (ICETITE)
abstract: Convolutional Neural Networks(CNN) are created to work mostly on the image datasets and have revolutionized image classification and object detection by introducing versatile architectures which can be modified according to the requirements needed with help of modifiable hyperparameters like architecture specifications, batch size, kernel, stride size, loss function, learning rate etc.,. The use of ResNet architecture introduces residual pathways which accelerates weight convergence compared to the traditional neural networks and other CNN architectures like AlexNet, LeNet, GoogLeNet by effectively preserves much patterns and informations contained in the images and giving a good accuracy in almost all cases considering the dataset size, quality and task complexity. In this proposed work, the CT images of Kidneys which are divided into train (1453 images) and test (346 images), encompassing both stones and non-stone cases. Employing ResNet50 architecture with meticulously configured hyperparameters and tailored preprocessing methods are made to learn the train data with a specific number of epochs and suggested learning rate. After training the model for 50 epochs, applied to detect stone's presence in the test set and achieved an accuracy of 93%. The limitations of conventional machine learning models in image classification tasks by considering Support Vector Machine, Logistic Regression and RandomForest demonstrates their challenges in capturing complex image patterns and features, often results in lower accuracy. And this deep learning model must need Graphics Processing Unit (GPU) for training to reduce the computation time and memory management.

articleTitle: Continuous Sign Language Recognition using Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Emerging Trends in Information Technology and Engineering (ICETITE)
abstract: Automatic Continuous Sign Language Recognition is a task that aims at associating words/phrases for sign language gestures. The scope of building a CSLR framework extends beyond bridging the communication barrier between the deaf community and the hearing majority but includes profound benefits such as bootstrapping translation systems, human-computer interaction, virtual reality environments, etc. In this study, a continuous sign language recognition framework based on a CNN architecture is proposed. Utilizing the Argentina Sign Language dataset, sign language gestures are preprocessed to extract training and testing frames. Employing transfer learning with the ResNet-50 model, a CNN is trained to classify each frame into one of 64 different words present in the dataset. The paper also conducts a thorough post-training data analysis, offering insights into areas where the model performed less effectively, identifying commonly confused pairs of sign language gestures. Additionally, a heatmap overlay technique is employed to elucidate the black-box CNN model.

articleTitle: Unveiling Insights: A Machine Learning Approach to Decipher Student Sentiments in Computer University of Myanmar
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Emerging Trends in Information Technology and Engineering (ICETITE)
abstract: This propose system addresses the crucial aspect of student feedback analysis in computer science courses at the Computer University of Myanmar. Acknowledging the significance of genuine feedback for educational improvement, the study integrates machine learning techniques and natural language processing for a comprehensive analysis. Three Google forms, tailored for curriculum, assessment, and learning outcomes, are utilized to collect both quantitative and qualitative data from students. The analysis pipeline involves preprocessing, text normalization, Bag of Words model construction, sentiment labeling, and TF-IDF feature extraction. Classification employs Support Vector Machine (SVM) and Naive Bayes classifiers, with varied strengths demonstrated across questionnaire forms. The results, presented the importance of selecting classifiers based on data context. SVM excels in positive class accuracy, particularly in assessment and learning outcomes, while Naive Bayes performs well in the curriculum. The study concludes by emphasizing the value of a combined SVM and Naive Bayes approach for a robust analysis and offers insights and methodologies for universities to enhance educational programs through meaningful feedback interpretation.

articleTitle: Power Quality Assessment of Distribution System Integrated with Wind Turbine Connected SRF-Controlled DSTATCOM
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Emerging Trends in Information Technology and Engineering (ICETITE)
abstract: The adoption of renewable energy sources for the generation of electric power is a beneficial necessity. One of the more motivating sources of generated electricity among them is wind-based generation. Power quality issues are brought about by grid-integrated wind turbines and loads powered by electronics. It becomes crucial to reduce harmonics and control reactive or voltage in the distribution system. A shunt customized power device called a distribution static compensator (DSTATCOM) is frequently used to solve problems with power quality in distribution networks. The DSTATCOM control technique serves as crucial for controlling reactive power because it injects current to stabilize voltage at the point of common coupling. This work proposes the Wind turbine coupled Distribution Static Compensator (DSTATCOM), which is simulated in the Library for SIMULINK in MATLAB, with the goal of reducing power quality issues in the distribution system and promoting active power to the load through the utilization of wind turbines. Through MATLAB simulation results, the performance of the Wind-DSTATCOM for unbalanced and non-linear loads is demonstrated using the SRF theory.

articleTitle: Design of a Portable, Customizable Device with GPS Integration to Track Location-Specific Realtime Outdoor PM2.5 Pollution Exposure
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Emerging Trends in Information Technology and Engineering (ICETITE)
abstract: This work focuses on developing a portable, cus-tomizable device with GPS integration for tracking location-specific realtime outdoor PM2.5 exposure. The device is powered by a dedicated rechargeable 5V power supply, which is helpful for outdoor applications. A commercially available, low-cost laser-based PM sensor (PMS5003) is used to detect PM2.5 concentrations. Data is gathered and processed, then stored in a micro SD card. A standard PM meter (Temtop M2000) was used to calibrate the designed PM meter. The device also measures meteorological parameters such as temperature and relative humidity. The device has tested and analyzed seasonal variations of PM2.5 concentration in a particular location due to temperature and relative humidity. The device is carried by a bicycle, and data is collected. From those data, it is tested to identify the pollution hotspots and map street-level variations in PM2.5 concentration in a city.

articleTitle: Weather-Adaptive Power Factor Management: A Machine Learning Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Emerging Trends in Information Technology and Engineering (ICETITE)
abstract: The low power factor condition is influenced by various aspects one of the main being weather and load variations, a clever and sophisticated solution is necessary. With suboptimal power factors leading to penalties as well as due to the weather changes, the consumption will also vary, a single policy won't solve all problems. We hope to study the effect of weather conditions on power factors and develop an auto-corrective system. Through supervised learning, using Logistic Regression, Support Vector Machine (SVM), Decision Trees, and Random Forest Models, we have attained a high precision of 93 %. Cross-validation further strengthens the reliability by more than 99.7 %. This solution adjusts capacitors in real time based on weather data, which optimizes the power factor as precisely as possible. This study paves the way for an intelligent method to resolve power factor problems, improving efficiency and avoiding financial penalties.

articleTitle: A Double Layer Encryption for Communication using Cryptographic Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Emerging Trends in Information Technology and Engineering (ICETITE)
abstract: Cryptography is a fundamental field in computer science that focuses on securing communication and protecting sensitive information from unauthorized access. It involves the use of mathematical algorithms and techniques to transform plaintext into ciphertext, rendering it unintelligible to anyone without the proper decryption key. Cryptographic systems play a crucial role in ensuring confidentiality, integrity, and authenticity of data in various domains, including finance, healthcare, e-commerce, and communication networks. In this paper, a double-layer encryption method is proposed that uses the Vigenere and Polybius ciphers to secure communication. The Vigenere cipher is a classical method that uses a keyword to encrypt plaintext, while the Polybius cipher is another classical cipher that uses a grid to map letters to two-digit numbers to encrypt data. By combining these two ciphers, the proposed algorithm aims to enhance the security of the data by introducing a more complex and secure encryption method. The proposed method is implemented using Python programming language with web implementation. The web implementation of the algorithm uses Flask, a Python web framework. This allows users to encrypt and decrypt their data through a user-friendly interface, making it more accessible and practical for real-world use. Based on the obtained results demonstrate that the proposed method provides a higher level of security compared to using each cipher individually, without significantly impacting the encryption and decryption speed. Overall, the proposed double-layer encryption method can be a useful tool for secure communication in various applications. It contributes to the field of cryptography by introducing a novel approach that enhances data security without compromising usability.

articleTitle: Mixed Algorithm Real Time Image Processing for Robotic Drones in Deterministic Environments
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Emerging Trends in Information Technology and Engineering (ICETITE)
abstract: This paper presents a mixed algorithm approach for real-time image processing on air and land based robotic drones that operate in highly deterministic environments such as automated warehouses. A combination of heuristic, multi state algorithmic solution based on Canny Edge and a CNN deep learning-based solution is proposed to ensure maximum performance out of low power embedded hardware. A heuristic i.e., rule-based approach is used for fixed, simple tasks such as navigation, docking, charging, identifying racks etc. On detecting an edge case or an anomaly beyond the scope of heuristics, the program switches to a deep learning-based approach in real time for extracting context and navigating the complex scenario. This computationally intense mode only lasts for short bursts and switches back to an appropriate, power efficient algorithm. The paper aims to study the effects of different embedded computer vision methodologies taking into account the context switching time and their effect on the computational resources such as CPU, RAM and ROM along with variations in CPU temperature and verify the effectiveness of a mixed algorithm approach on a Raspberry Pi 4 single board computer running “Raspbian Bookworm” a 64bit Debian based operating system interfaced with a CSI Camera for visual feed.

articleTitle: Dynamic Charging Lane for Authenticated Electric Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Emerging Trends in Information Technology and Engineering (ICETITE)
abstract: In recent years, the automobile landscape has witnessed a notable shift as an increasing number of individuals and societies are contemplating a transition from traditional petrol or diesel-powered vehicles to the innovative realm of Electric Vehicles. This paper introduces the concept of Dynamic Charging Lane (DCL) designed specifically for authenticated electric vehicles. The paper also provides an in-depth exploration of the technical aspects of the DCL system, which is demonstrated through the utilization of SUMO (Simulation Of Urban Mobility). The paper underscores the distinctive attributes of the DCL system, including its ability to offer real-time authentication for electric vehicle (EV) users and dynamic power transfer capabilities. The utilization of SUMO offers a comprehensive visual representation of the DCL system's operations within a realistic urban mobility context. This paper aims to shed light on the technology's potential to transform the future of electric vehicle charging while advancing the goals of sustainability and efficiency in the transportation sector.

articleTitle: Early Detection of Down Syndrome Through Ultrasound Imaging Using Deep Learning Strategies — A Review
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Emerging Trends in Information Technology and Engineering (ICETITE)
abstract: Another name for Down syndrome is Trisomy 21, which is a complex chromosomal disorder that poses a substantial challenge in prenatal care due to its widespread prevalence. An additional copy of chromosome 21 is the defining feature of this disorder, leading to numerous physical and cognitive impairments. Typical physical traits of Down syndrome include a flattened facial structure, most notably in the nose bridge region, as well as upward-slanted almond-shaped eyes and a shortened neck. Apart from these features, individuals with Down syndrome also experience a range of intellectual disabilities, spanning from mild to severe. These challenges manifest in various areas, such as expressive communication, verbal memory, and attention. Furthermore, children with this disorder may exhibit behavioral issues that require special attention and care. Early and accurate detection of this condition is essential for informed decision-making by expectant parents. This review explores an overview of the data sets and results of recent studies that have used deep learning and machine learning methodologies to create effective models for the identification of Down syndrome.

articleTitle: Blockchain Based E-Voting System
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Emerging Trends in Information Technology and Engineering (ICETITE)
abstract: Online voting has been a subject of study for many years. The credibility of the technology, or where the solution rests in counting, is where the validity of the votes is at great risk. Additionally, the transactions need to be secure. This study was conducted to determine how Blockchain Technology will affect the security of online voting systems. Blockchain is a cutting-edge computing technology that is little known to the general public. The influence of Bitcoin has nevertheless demonstrated the legitimacy of Blockchain as a Blockchain application, which has revolutionized Fintech. The decentralized nature of the Blockchain is its key characteristic. To safeguard the data, this prevents it from being stored in a single location and instead distributes it throughout the network. There is no wrong in a decentralized system. By doing so, a programmer is prevented from attacking the frame even if they only target a single block in the structure that has no bearing on the frame. Stream The US-based application My Vote is utilized for a trusted trust voting design that relies on regulatory advances to track the voting process continually. Blondes' innovation is employed in the alternative electoral system known as Election Runner. Security is the most well-known risk that all e-administrations face. By utilizing blockchain technology, the web-based democratic platform can find a solution to this problem. The advancement of blockchain technology has the potential to shift power and trust away from the main entertainers.

articleTitle: Enhancing User Authentication with a Secure Human-Computable Password Scheme
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Emerging Trends in Information Technology and Engineering (ICETITE)
abstract: Authentication in the digital world has become a challenging and difficult task. The username-password combination is no longer reliable and the tools that support authentication mechanism are all breakable. In addition to authentication, to avoid bots, CAPTCHA is used which increases the complexity of the system. Thus the research is going towards making use of human brain which is so unique and powerful in the authentication process. This will also eliminate the need for CAPTCHA since human is computing the password. To make it feasible, the function that is computed by the human should be simple enough. The existing method trusts the computer to store the public images and if there is a key logger installed in the system, the adversary will be able to get the password. This again tends to be a fixed password. Instead, if it is based on a challenge from the server, the password will be dynamic and secure. In this paper a human computable password protocol is suggested. The experimental results prove that the proposed technique is efficient and is less prone to attacks.

articleTitle: Guardians of Grids: A Novel Method for Identifying High-Voltage Insulator Flaws
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Emerging Trends in Information Technology and Engineering (ICETITE)
abstract: This research introduces a methodology, for identifying flaws in high-voltage insulators. These flaws include damage, broken shells and overall integrity assessment. Insulators play a role in power transmission so it is essential to examine them to ensure grid reliability. Our automated system provides a cost-effective solution that serves as a defence, against potential power disruptions. This proposed solution with YOLOv8 focuses on fortifying the resilience of power grids by uncovering and addressing vulnerabilities in insulator shells. The proposed method has achieved high accuracy 98.2% and 99% precision.

articleTitle: Enhancing User Authentication through Keystroke Dynamics Analysis using Isolation Forest algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Emerging Trends in Information Technology and Engineering (ICETITE)
abstract: Authentication in modern era, has evolved significantly to address the increasing complexity and security challenges of our digital world. Traditional methods of authentication, such as passwords and PINS have proven to be vulnerable to various forms of attacks. As a result there is a growing need for innovative and robust authentication techniques. Keystroke dynamics involves the analysis of user typing patterns, including the time interval between keystrokes and the key pressed duration, to establish a unique biometric profile for each individual. Unlike traditional authentication methods keystroke dynamics offer several advantages, such as continuous authentication without the need for additional hardware and the ability to adapt to a user's changing typing behavior. This model will additionally analyze users typing patterns have the capability to identify individuals using the system by considering their typing speed. The first premise involves developing a system that can capture the keystroke dynamics of a user during a training phase and create a unique profile for that user. The second premise involves implementing Mahalanobis distance for Dynamic keystroke Authentication with various machine learning algorithms. This model can maximize the strengths of both methods to improve the accuracy and robustness of the authentication system. Authentication using keystroke dynamics is secured and convenient method and can be used wherever there is requirement of authentication such as baking, e-commerce and secured access control system. From the experiment performed below we can attained that the model functions exceptionally well using Isolation Forest with an accuracy of 90%.

articleTitle: Conformal Triangular Slotted Antenna for Rocket Sounding Application
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Emerging Trends in Information Technology and Engineering (ICETITE)
abstract: An antenna on the sounding rocket is necessary, so it can receive and transmit signals to the ground station. This paper presents the design and simulation of a conformal triangular slotted antenna for sounding rocket application. The proposed antenna is intended to work at the frequencies of 0.91 GHz and 2.45 GHz for radio telemetry and 1.575 GHz for Global Positioning System (GPS) channel L1. It is designed on a 0.254 mm thick Rogers/Duroid 5880 dielectric substrate with a relative permittivity of 2.2 and dimensions of 228.6 mm × 304.8 mm. The antenna consists of a 1 ×2 array for telemetry and a single element for GPS L1. The antenna is excited with proximity coupling which is fed to coaxial cable from below the substrate. The result shows that the proposed antenna can work at the frequencies of 0.91 GHz, 1.575 GHz, and 2.45 GHz with the reflection coefficient values maintained less than -10 dB. These three frequencies have fractional bandwidths of 0.85%, 1.86%, and 1.3%, respectively. The 3 dB axial ratio bandwidth for GPS L1 antenna achieves 80 MHz. Furthermore, the radiation patterns are omnidirectional with the gains at these frequencies are 2.78 dBi, -3.19 dBi, and 3.02 dBi, respectively.

articleTitle: Enhancing Data Security Using Steganography in Spatial Domain Images
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Emerging Trends in Information Technology and Engineering (ICETITE)
abstract: The evolution of technology in transmitting information across public networks has highlighted the need to focus on data security to safeguard information.
