publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Emerging Trends in Information Technology and Engineering (ICETITE)
abstract: This paper introduces an advanced automated information management system, addressing the critical need for effective transcription and summarization in the face of the burgeoning volume of video data. The study's objective is to overcome the limitations of existing methods, primarily in handling vast video transcriptions and enhancing information retrieval. We propose an innovative integration of Mozilla Deep Speech, LangChain, VectorDB, and Large Language Models (LLMs), aiming to significantly improve the efficiency and accuracy of document-oriented processes in various sectors. Our approach leverages generative AI to transform the way organizations process video content, offering a solution to the lengthy and often challenging transcription tasks that current technologies struggle with. We highlight the potential economic impact, as underscored by a McKinsey study, indicating a substantial contribution of these technologies to various industries, particularly in customer service, sales, marketing, and software development. The methodology encompasses a comprehensive system architecture, utilizing NLP techniques and models like BERT, GPT, and spaCy, addressing the shortcomings of existing approaches with enhanced precision and adaptability. Initial findings demonstrate a transformative improvement in video summarization, providing significant benefits in education, journalism, and accessibility for the hearing impaired. This research not only offers a novel solution to existing challenges in data management but also sets a new standard for the application of generative AI and LLMs in automated information processing.

articleTitle: Exploring the Role of Deep Learning in Coconut Palm Diseases and Detecting Red Palm Weevil in Early Stage Amidst Advances and Challenges —a Review
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Emerging Trends in Information Technology and Engineering (ICETITE)
abstract: The RPW(Red Palm Weevil) is commonly regarded as the most harmful insect pest to palm trees worldwide. Larvae of the RPW (Red Palm Weevil)consume the apical growth point of the tree, severely affect the tissues, and damage the structure of the trunk. By RPW, injury to the palm tree may present: (1) The trunk and base of the fronds develop tunnels. (2) Because of the larvae feeding inside, infected trees make “gnawing” noises. (3) Sticky liquids drip through the tunnel. The finding of the weevil is a key feature in saving the tree from extensive harm and loss. Since the detection and control of conventional techniques are costly and difficult to maintain with proper time management, innovative ideas are required. The proposed work is a smart, environmentally friendly approach to red palm weevil management approach. The system, based on multiple sensor fusion, is to analyze the infested signal and process it. It wirelessly communicates the infested status to the owner for further prevention measures. The key objective is to develop a detection system by examining the Red Palm weevil in its larval stage by its sound.

articleTitle: Advancements in Multi-Objective Personalized Drug Design: A Comprehensive Review of Innovative Approaches and Technologies
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Emerging Trends in Information Technology and Engineering (ICETITE)
abstract: This comprehensive review paper presents an in-depth exploration of diverse approaches employed in multi-objective personalized drug design, encompassing cutting-edge methodologies that leverage advanced technologies. The multifaceted landscape of drug design is scrutinized through the lenses of neural network approaches, stochastic modeling, decentralization, blockchain-based solutions, topological optimization strategies, genetic algorithm optimization, energy consumption optimization, and blockchain-based pharmaceutical supply chain management. Each approach's unique strengths and applications are thoroughly examined, shedding light on their respective contributions to the burgeoning field of personalized medicine. This review not only synthesizes the current state of research but also identifies opportunities for synergistic integration of these approaches to further enhance the precision and efficacy of personalized drug design, ultimately paving the way for a transformative era in healthcare.

articleTitle: Enhanced Movie Recommendation System Using Temporal Gradient Entropy
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Emerging Trends in Information Technology and Engineering (ICETITE)
abstract: Recommendation systems play a crucial role in many industries such as e-commerce and entertainment. Since consumers in today's world are confronted with a lot of choices, recommendation systems help in filtering choices and will improve user experience. This increases the users’ satisfaction and encourages them to continue to engage with the product or service. In the current days, businesses also can take advantage from recommender systems because such systems allow the business and revenue streams to grow by improving user retention and engagement. Additionally, businesses can gather useful information and trends in the consumption of content which can then be leveraged by business intelligence for further analysis and other business opportunities. Thus, this research focuses on yet another novel approach on building recommendation algorithms which can perform more satisfactory recommendations to users by using the concept of “Temporal Gradient Entropy”. This approach tries to capture the temporal dynamics and trends in user preferences and measures the changes in the user's interactions over time. The dataset used in this research to demonstrate the advantages of Temporal Gradient Entropy is the Netflix Prize dataset. This dataset is released by Netflix officially and consists of over 480K users and 17K movies with their respective movie ratings along with the date when the rating was given. The dataset is cleaned and processed by the big data processing framework Hadoop and MapReduce, after which the cleaned data was used to calculate the Temporal Gradient Entropy. We highlight the approach and showcase the results of calculating the Temporal Gradient Entropy and using this metric together with modern Machine Learning models such as Singular Value Decomposition (SVD) to perform satisfactory recommendations.

articleTitle: Attacks and Defenses Against Poison and Evasion Attacks on COVID-19 Detection Models
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Emerging Trends in Information Technology and Engineering (ICETITE)
abstract: COVID-19 detection models are crucial for accurately identifying infected individuals during the pandemic. However, these models face vulnerabilities to attacks, such as the Projected Gradient Decent (PGD) algorithm, which aims to deceive the models by generating slight modifications to input data to cause misclassification. This research investigates the PGD algorithm as an attacking technique on COVID-19 detection models and proposes effective defense strategies to counter its impact. The results highlight the importance of developing defenses against the PGD algorithm to safeguard COVID-19 detection models. By integrating Data Sanitization mechanisms, the models' ability to resist adversarial attacks is enhanced, ensuring their accuracy and reliability in identifying infected individuals. By understanding the intricacies of the PGD algorithm and implementing effective defense strategies, stakeholders can strengthen the security and trustworthiness of COVID-19 detection models. This research contributes to the development of resilient models, facilitating their reliable deployment in critical healthcare settings and public health interventions while mitigating the risks associated with adversarial attacks.

articleTitle: Integrity Estimation of Twitter Based Event Recognition Using Scrutiny of Analyzed Data
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Emerging Trends in Information Technology and Engineering (ICETITE)
abstract: Twitter has been observed to be one of the essential data resources for dependable event accreditation. articleTitle: Impact of Electrode Materials on Battery Performance in Hybrid Systems for EV Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Emerging Trends in Information Technology and Engineering (ICETITE)
abstract: To increase the performance and efficiency of electric vehicles, Researchers are actively involved in innovative energy storage methods. This research paper mainly focuses on the performance and modeling of batteries and the working of an integrated hybrid battery-supercapacitor system. Since supercapacitors have quick charging and discharging capability, it is used in many high-power applications. Generally, Lithium-ion batteries have high energy density but it has some limitations in quick charging and discharging. This hybrid system includes characteristics of both supercapacitors and Lithium-ion batteries to solve electric vehicle difficulties like power density, energy density, and cycle life. In this paper to improve the battery parameters, the Lithium-ion battery model is constructed with chemical compositions such as NCA and LMO using COMSOL. It is responsible for reduction reactions in electrochemical processes, impacts the flow of electrical current, and has an impact on crucial parameters such as energy density and cycle life. Thus, integrating both battery and supercapacitors helps in the performance of the total integrated system.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Deep Learning and Machine Learning for Detection and Classification of Brain Tumors at Multiple Stages
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Emerging Trends in Information Technology and Engineering (ICETITE)
abstract: The brain acts as the body's command central location. As time goes on, more and more brain illnesses are pinpointed. Because of this diversity, improving current methods of diagnosing or detecting brain illnesses is a constant focus of study. The effectiveness of treatment for disorders of the brain can be greatly improved by catching them early. Recent years have seen the widespread adoption of AI across the scientific community, and without a doubt, this has had a profound impact on neurology. Brain disease diagnosis and prognosis have both benefited from AI's incorporation into the medical industry. Cancer of the brain is a major killer in the world today. Because of these characteristics, there are many ways to check for brain cancer. Prompt diagnosis is essential for effective treatment of brain tumors. One such technique is magnetic resonance imaging. In contrast, state-of-the-art approaches have been employed to address several classification-related challenges in medical imaging in recent years. These include deep learning, neural networks, and machine learning. To differentiate between glioma, meningioma, pituitary, and no tumour in patients with brain cancer, the SVM classifier in machine learning (ML) was utilized in this study. The information in this study comes from people's contrast-enhanced MRI images. This study provides a comparison between the suggested model and competing models to prove the superiority of our method. Both the raw data and the data after it had been cleaned and supplemented were evaluated. In this research, we explore the possibility of using deep learning and other advanced machine learning approaches to spot brain abnormalities. To be noteworthy concerns with machine learning/deep learning-based methodologies for identifying brain illnesses are discussed, and the most noteworthy findings from the publications we analyzed are presented. The ultimate purpose of the research is to determine the best method for diagnosing various forms of brain diseases.

articleTitle: Digital Regimen for Parkinson Disease: An Informative Approach Using Mobile Application
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Emerging Trends in Information Technology and Engineering (ICETITE)
abstract: Parkinson's disease (PD) is an advanced neuro-degenerative condition where a large number of people around the world are profoundly affected. The scarcity of precise data regarding the typical circumstances faced by humans with PD severely restricts ongoing research and therapeutic endeavours. This proposed work aims to investigate various innovations to address this issue comprehensively. Specifically, this proposed work intends to develop a versatile application tailored to help the PD patients and incorporating smart medication reminders. Moreover, this proposed work will focus on creating exercise/workout plans & diet plans based on continuous data collection and patient feedback to enhance prescription management while minimizing side effects. Simultaneously, initiatives aimed at reducing the stress level and improve mental health. The development and implementation of this versatile applications hold significant promise in improving patient outcomes. By addressing the dearth of accurate information and fostering a systematic support ecosystem, it aspires to enhance the lives of individuals grappling with PD on a global scale.

articleTitle: ETGAN: A Hybrid GAN Ensemble for Synthesizing Time-Dependent and Static Tabular Data
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Emerging Trends in Information Technology and Engineering (ICETITE)
abstract: The increasing reliance on data-driven decisions across industries has accentuated the importance of machine learning models. However, these models often encounter challenges that can be effectively addressed by ensuring the provision of quality data in large quantities. This is where GANs are thriving as they help to tackle data shortage and privacy issues by generating synthetic data that is statistically similar to the original data. Enterprise data is mostly tabular and the existing GAN algorithms have limited focus on tabular data. Most of these GANs focus on only static or point-in-time tabular data and very few of them focus on time series or dynamic data. Therefore, there is a crucial need for a generic model capable of generating both static and time-dependent features in tabular data, given that real-world business problems involve both static and time-dependent or time-series values. In this paper, by using GAN architecture embedded with a transformer, we propose a novel methodology to generate synthetic data that is a mix of static and time-dependent or time-series features. This work presents underlying mathematical principles and empirical evaluations that demonstrate superior performance compared to existing models, showcasing improved sample quality and diversity. We support our claim with experimental results and conclude that the proposed state-of-the-art methodology is better than the existing architectures.

articleTitle: The Quest for Efficient Search Algorithms: Uninformed vs Informed Approaches
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Emerging Trends in Information Technology and Engineering (ICETITE)
abstract: This paper explores two types of search algorithms: uninformed search and informed search. Both these types are discussed into detail and some of the specific algorithms, that is, Breadth First Search, Depth First Search, Best First Search, Bidirectional Search, A* search, Uniform Cost Search are compared and analyzed. The real-life applications are described for each of them and the differences in the pseudo-code and graph are studied with respective examples.

articleTitle: Generating 3D Models for Prototyping of Virtual Environments using NeRF
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Emerging Trends in Information Technology and Engineering (ICETITE)
abstract: In the current technological landscape, technologies such as Metaverse, 3D printing, AR/VR applications, and game development require 3D models to build the environment around us for greater immersion. Thus, there is a need to speed up the 3D modelling process. There exist 3D reconstruction models like Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF) and Structure From Motion (SfM). However, pure NeRF converges extremely slowly on the model as it is generic (i.e it works on all types of objects). A way to optimize the generation of 3D models is to take advantage of a standard structure of the desired object class itself. Hence, a model is proposed, consisting of SlowFast CNN for structural feature extraction, Edge Collapsing for rejecting outliers and reducing complexity, which can generate 3D models of any desired class of objects, by training the model on the desired class of objects. The method samples the points to generate a point cloud, identifies the structure to which it most strictly adheres and generates a consistent mesh from these points and the defined structure, and to further reduce complexity, uses Edge Collapsing algorithm to fit unusual points to their nearest consistent fit. For comparison with other 3D reconstruction methods, a CLIP Similarity Score of 0.542 was obtained in an average execution time of 3.27 minutes.

articleTitle: Cardiomegaly Prediction Using Computer Vision
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Emerging Trends in Information Technology and Engineering (ICETITE)
abstract: Cardiomegaly, the enlargement of the heart, poses a significant challenge in the field of healthcare. Outdated diagnostic methods often lead to delayed detection and intervention. This project presents an innovative solution employing artificial intelligence (AI) to predict cardiomegaly. By leveraging computer vision techniques on medical imaging data, specifically chest X-rays, this system aims to automate the identification and prediction of cardiomegaly. Through AI-driven analysis and feature extraction, the project seeks to provide accurate and timely diagnoses, facilitating early intervention and treatment. Key factors such as image-based indicators, patient demographics, and clinical history are considered in the prediction process. By enhancing the accuracy of cardiomegaly prediction, this initiative contributes to improved patient outcomes and healthcare efficiency. The project also offers a user-friendly interface for healthcare professionals, making it accessible and practical in clinical settings.

articleTitle: Recommending the Rules Related to Course Grades in Education Sector using SKCAAR Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Emerging Trends in Information Technology and Engineering (ICETITE)
abstract: In Education Sector, Recommendation System (RS) is used to indicate areas where students require strengthening their knowledge. This RS is also used to predict students’ academic performance in terms of grade in the courses. In this research article, we developed the recommendation system for suggesting students’ grade in the course based on grade obtained by other students in the course. For this RS, we collected the data from university result ledgers of four year Computer Science and Engineering Programme for Academic Year 2014-15 and prepared ten datasets. These ten datasets contain courses grade of semester-wise, year-wise and overall performance. We defined the terms – relevant and irrelevant rules for RS. The rule is relevant if it contains courses either prerequisite courses to each other or dependent on each other otherwise the rule is irrelevant. For this RS, we designed the algorithm named as SK<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">C</sup>A<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">AR</sup> algorithm which uses Simple K-means clustering algorithm and Apriori Association Rule algorithm. We applied this SK<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">C</sup>A<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">AR</sup> algorithm on generated ten datasets and compared with the result of A<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">AR</sup> algorithm which uses only Apriori Association Rule algorithm. It is found that number of recommendation rules obtained using SK<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">C</sup>A<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">AR</sup> algorithm is more than five to twenty times than number of recommendation rules obtained using A<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">AR</sup> algorithm.

articleTitle: Reliability Analysis of PMSM Drives Processor for Commercial Electric Vehicle Utility
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Emerging Trends in Information Technology and Engineering (ICETITE)
abstract: The power electronic components of industrial drives are housed in sophisticated environmental conditions as they are subjected to fixed operating conditions. Unfortunately, this is not possible in the case of Electrical Vehicles (EV), as operating conditions vary from location to location and region to region. Due to these switching operating conditions, its reliability is still a matter of concern, especially its processor. The EVs processor controls all the application layers and its faults have tendency to cause a severe road accident. To fill this gap, a quantitative reliability analysis is carried out. Firstly, the thermal behavior of the Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor (PMSM) drive is analyzed using Piecewise Linear Electrical Circuit Simulation (PLECS). Later, a reliability study of the motor controller is carried out to identify the most vulnerable component under various temperature stress conditions using Advanced Logistics Development (ALD) failure rate estimation tool. Further, the reliability analysis is extended by considering the processor fault at the same operating temperature stress conditions. Considering the results, this critical and quantitative investigation is expected to have a significant impact on the EV processor's future reliability and design.

articleTitle: Street Light Cum Garbage System Optimal Design Based on IOT
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Emerging Trends in Information Technology and Engineering (ICETITE)
abstract: Street lights currently use more energy than other types of lighting because of an inefficient mechanism that makes the bulbs use a lot of electricity. The suggested approach uses various sensors on intelligent streetlights to keep an eye on and manage the lights. It has sensors for measuring temperature, brightness, and power that control dimming levels and keep track of status. One Zigbee network serves as the connection point for these lights. In the modification, a cloud- and IoT-based installation was made. Through Zigbee -based data transmission, sensor values are recorded on a distant server known as the Cloud. Additionally, it lowers electricity theft. We include a trash can notice in addition to this street light idea. When the garbage can is whole, a machine automatically notifies the business as people approach the sun, and the brightness of the street lights changes or is increased.

articleTitle: Personal Exercise Trainer Using Computer Vision
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Emerging Trends in Information Technology and Engineering (ICETITE)
abstract: The Personal Trainer online application tracks users progress and offers realtime feedback to encourage users in their daily workout routines. To identify and analyze human body movements, the program uses the mediapipe library, which integrates opencv and machine learning methods. The Personal Trainer online app provides an engaging and immersive workout experience by incorporating these technologies. The application supports several exercises, including weightlifting, squats, bicep curls, and pull-ups. The software uses the webcam on the computer to record realtime footage of the user completing the workout after they choose it. The user's body motions are then recognized from the recorded video using opencv and mediapipe, and performance-based feedback is given. Users may quickly move through the various training modes, check their activity history, and measure their overall progress thanks to the app's user-friendly and intuitive interface.

articleTitle: EcoStream SmartFlow System
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Emerging Trends in Information Technology and Engineering (ICETITE)
abstract: Agriculture, the backbone of our food supply, faces increasingly daunting challenges due to changing climate patterns and water scarcity. The efficient utilization of water resources has become paramount to ensure sustainable food production while conserving this precious commodity. This project introduces a Smart Irrigation System designed to address these challenges by harnessing the power of temperature and humidity sensors. The core concept of this system is to provide an intelligent, automated solution for delivering the right amount of water to crops precisely when they need it. This is achieved through the integration of sensors that continuously monitor the surrounding environment. Specifically, temperature and humidity sensors are strategically placed in the agricultural field. The signal serves as a trigger for a microcontroller, the brain of the system. By responding to real-time environmental cues, the system ensures that water is delivered only when necessary, eliminating the inefficiencies associated with scheduled irrigation or manual monitoring. The benefits of this Smart Irrigation. Moreover, by responding dynamically to changing conditions, it enhances crop health and yield, ultimately improving the economic viability of agriculture. In conclusion, this project represents a technological leap towards sustainable and efficient agriculture. By incorporating temperature and humidity sensors into the irrigation process, it empowers farmers to adapt to a changing climate, conserve water, and increase their agricultural output. This Smart Irrigation System holds the promise of transforming traditional farming practices into smart, resource-efficient, and environmentally responsible endeavors.

articleTitle: Development of a Crop Recommendation System Through the Use of Various Machine Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Emerging Trends in Information Technology and Engineering (ICETITE)
abstract: The agricultural sector holds immense significance in ensuring global food security and economic stability. Machine learning approaches have garnered increasing attention for agricultural purposes in the past few years, especially when it comes to crop recommendation systems. This research endeavors to introduce and assess various machine learning algorithms deployed in a crop recommendation system, with the primary objective of aiding farmers in making well-informed decisions regarding crop selection, considering their unique environmental and soil conditions. The study relies on a comprehensive data set encompassing vital elements including soil composition, climatic trends, past crop yields, and agronomic techniques. Predictive models are generated by utilizing a variety of machine learning algorithms, such as neural networks, decision trees, random forests, and support vector machines. To understand the complex interactions between environmental factors and crop performance, these models are trained using historical data. To assess how well these models work in terms of suggesting appropriate crops under circumstances, performance metrics including accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score are used in the evaluation process. Moreover, the research delves into the interpretability of these models to offer insights into the decision-making process, catering to both farmers and agricultural experts. Furthermore, the study discusses the practical implementation of these models into a user-friendly web application, thus enhancing accessibility for farmers. This application solicits input from users, including geographical location, soil attributes, and climate data, subsequently generating personalized crop recommendations based on the insights gleaned from machine learning models. The findings of this study highlight how machine learning algorithms can greatly assist farmers in choosing crops that are specific to their needs. Such help may increase agricultural productivity, maximize resource allocation, and improve agriculture's general sustainability. The study also emphasizes the significance of judiciously selecting appropriate algorithms and data preprocessing techniques to achieve optimal performance. To sum up, this study advances the field of precision agriculture by demonstrating how machine learning algorithms may be applied practically in crop recommendation systems. It highlights the capacity of technology-driven solutions to tackle contemporary challenges in agriculture, ultimately benefiting both farmers and the global food supply chain.

articleTitle: Development of a Position Tracking Algorithm Through a Novel Nearest Neighbor Classifier
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Emerging Trends in Information Technology and Engineering (ICETITE)
abstract: Object detection is a crucial task with numerous applications. The ability to detect changes in an object requires monitoring its behavior over time to recognize any alterations. This task is crucial in various domains, ranging from basic image analysis to remote sensing applications, where understanding geographic changes is of utmost importance. For example, in the production of printed circuit boards and integrated circuits, detecting component errors is essential. Similarly, in astronomy, tracking the movement of astronomical objects and changes in land cover due to tectonic plate deviations are of great interest. Change detection and tracking models are therefore in high demand. However, current models that use Earth Mover’ Distance (EMD) for binary classification of object changes have limited applications. Therefore, an alternate position change identification model that can function as a substitute for deep learning methods is required. In this study, we propose a model that utilizes Mean Square Error (MSE)in place of EMD and considers the variation in image intensity from pixel to pixel to improve accuracy. Moreover, to overcome the limitations of binary classification our model categorizes images into multiple groups based on their chronological position. This enables us to identify the differences between various time periods more accurately. To train and evaluate our model, we use synthetic images, allowing us to create a model that can function with less data compared to current methods. Overall, our proposed model can significantly improve object change detection in various domains, making it a valuable addition to the field.

articleTitle: Efficient and Secure Deep Learning Asynchronous Training in Serverless P2P Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Emerging Trends in Information Technology and Engineering (ICETITE)
abstract: In this work, we leverage the power of AWS Lambda and S3 buckets to propose a revolutionary method for peer-to- peer deep learning. Unlike traditional synchronous approaches, ours adopts asynchronous training, enabling every peer to advance independently. By guaranteeing the integrity and confidentiality of transferred data, encryption techniques improve data security during communication. By reducing data transfer overhead and maximizing parallelism, dataset partitioning makes effective model training possible. The peer-to-peer deep learning landscape is redefined by this decentralized, secure, and scalable architecture, which promises significant gains in efficiency and model convergence.

Author Keywords: Decentralized Deep Learning Peer-to-Peer AR chitecture Serverless Computing Asynchronous Training AWS Lambda S3 Buckets Encryption Protocols Data Security Dataset Partitioning Parallelism Model Training Efficiency Scalability Deep Learning Framework Privacy Enhancement Distributed Computing

articleTitle: A Literary Survey for Blockchain Application for Supply Chain Management of Farm Produces
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Emerging Trends in Information Technology and Engineering (ICETITE)
abstract: The size of the global blockchain market in food supply chains and agricultural activities was expected to reach USD 133 million in 2020. The growing need among stakeholders to track and trace the finished goods and raw materials is what is driving this expansion, as it builds trust among all parties involved. Because customers are growing more conscious of provenance, more players in the food industry are turning to blockchain technology. But only organized food retailers and branded corporations may benefit from blockchain applications and traceability. There is no system in place to validate data in real time, nor is there any guarantee of the standard of the raw commodities used in the food sector. However, neither producers nor customers—two groups from opposite ends of the supply chain—benefit financially from the conventional method. Labels with embedded barcodes, QR's and monitoring technologies will help farmers get paid more and promote confidence in the quality of their produce thanks to a bespoke blockchain for traceability. A model that promotes end-to-end services also bolsters the transparency in the system, and makes it easier for the parties involved to track their interests, be it the delivery or the payments.

articleTitle: Classification of Lung Diseases Using Transfer Learning with Chest X-Ray Images
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Emerging Trends in Information Technology and Engineering (ICETITE)
abstract: Millions of people worldwide are impacted by lung illnesses, which are a major cause of morbidity and mortality. An accurate and timely diagnosis is essential for managing and treating conditions effectively. A useful non-invasive technique for identifying and categorizing a range of lung disorders, chest X- ray imaging enables prompt treatment and better patient outcomes. This research describes an extensive study that develops and evaluates a classification based on deep learning model using the Chest X-ray images Dataset from National Institutes of Health (NIH), which covers a wide spectrum of thoracic anomalies. Astrong model could be developed thanks to the dataset, which included 112,120 images with annotations taken from radiological reports utilizing approaches from Natural Language Processing (NLP) techniques. Pre-trained architectures like ResNet and specially created Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), trained with a weighted loss technique to manage data imbalance, are among the models that have been put into practise. Through extensive exploratory data analysis, preparation procedures, model training, and evaluation, the research offers insights into the performance and accuracy of each illness class's classification. At 83.57%, ResNet50 has the highest accuracy, followed by Custom CNN at 78.25%. ResNet18's accuracy was 72.67%, whereas VGG19's accuracy was 67.12%. ResNet50 is the most accurate of these models, while VGG19 performs less accurately.

articleTitle: Enhancement in Context-Aware Recommender Systems – A Systematic Review
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Emerging Trends in Information Technology and Engineering (ICETITE)
abstract: A Recommendation System is a crucial Machine Learning algorithm that provides suggestions for various applications and uses computer algorithms or software to analyse and predict user preferences between products, content, services, or information. Within the realm, Recommendation Systems have become vital tools, utilizing Machine Learning algorithms to provide valuable suggestions across various applications. However, traditional Recommendation System encounters challenges related to scalability, sparsity, cold start issues, lack of diversity, and context-based recommendation, which results in user dissatisfaction and limited engagement. Addressing these issues, this study embarks on a comprehensive survey to propose a Context-Aware Recommendation System that integrates contextual factors such as the user's geographical position, current timing, emotional state, company, social engagements, psychological well-being, atmospheric conditions, direction, life stage, sensory information, gender, and personal profile. The survey meticulously investigates the potential enhancement of the Context-Aware Recommendation System by applying Deep Learning methodologies. The survey critically assesses and explores how advanced Deep Learning techniques can synergize with Context-Aware Recommendation System technology, overcome the limitations of current contextual systems, and ultimately optimize the recommendation process for an enriched user experience and enhanced system efficiency.

articleTitle: OcuVision:CNN powered Analysis of Retinal images for Disease Diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Emerging Trends in Information Technology and Engineering (ICETITE)
abstract: In numerous areas of the world, retinal disorders are a major factor in vision loss and blindness. Early recognition and detection of various conditions, including diabetic retinopathy,macular degeneration, and glaucoma, are essential for avoiding irreversible vision loss.We intend to develop a multi-class retinal illness diagnosis method utilizing deep CNNs that is effective. Convolutional neural networks (CNNs) are utilized by the suggested EyeDeep-Net multi-layer neural network to extract pertinent information from fundus images and make diagnostic assessments. The technology holds promise for utilization in telemedicine scenarios,healthcare settings and point-of-care gadgets with limited resources, enabling the prompt identification of diseases and rapid intervention. The accuracy of the model is evaluated using multiple statistical criteria, showing better performance in both disease diagnosis and classification when compared to many modern baseline models. In order to train and assess the suggested deep learning model, this study makes use of the RFMiD dataset, a useful resource. What sets this work apart is the systematic analysis of different optimizers applied to the EyeDeep-Net architecture, which aims to enhance the model's performance and accuracy. The optimization process is vital in tailoring the model to achieve superior results in retinal disease diagnosis.

articleTitle: A Predictive Model for Marine Debris Prediction (A Comparative Case Study)
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Emerging Trends in Information Technology and Engineering (ICETITE)
abstract: Efficient removal of marine debris is imperative for safeguarding public health and the environment, particularly marine ecosystems. This research addresses the limitations of conventional methods, such as image detection and satellite data, which often exhibit an accuracy below 85% in estimating waste levels in specific geographic areas. Our primary objective is to enhance predictive accuracy by leveraging machine learning and deep learning algorithms that capitalize on historical waste generation patterns. Through an exhaustive exploration of various algorithms documented in research papers, we aim to identify the most suitable model, whether multimodal or hybrid, to improve accuracy. Performance assessment will be conducted using key metrics such as Root Mean Squared Error (RMSE), Mean Absolute Error (MAE), and Mean Absolute Percentage Error (MAPE). This comprehensive approach holds the potential for significant advancements in marine debris management and environmental protection.

articleTitle: Utilization of UAVs to Detect and Locate Safe Sites in Disaster Affected Area Using Geo-Referencing
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Emerging Trends in Information Technology and Engineering (ICETITE)
abstract: Over the years the change in global climatic conditions, like the greenhouse effect, and global warming have led to sudden increases in natural disasters mostly weather, climates, and water extremes. which has led to the loss of lives, and resources and affected the economies adversely. While on the one hand the efforts to prevent disasters and the natural habitat of the earth are continued, we have to also be prepared for sudden cases. As much as the prediction of disaster is important in planning rescue missions, the post-disaster process and planning are also crucial, which actually decide the impact of the disaster. In this paper, our approach lies in the post-disaster Response phase, where we take immediate actions after the disaster hits. Drones will be used to access the site and find some safe spots in the affected area which can be used by the rescue team to build safe sites, store goods, accumulate hostiles, or shape their rescue mission in many ways.

articleTitle: Android App based Battery Management System with Charging Station Locator for Electric Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Emerging Trends in Information Technology and Engineering (ICETITE)
abstract: The abstract discusses the importance of using environmentally friendly energy and the increasing use of electric vehicles. It emphasizes the significance of a battery management system (BMS) in ensuring safe and dependable battery operation in electric cars. The thesis proposes designing and implementing a lithium-ion battery management system for automotive applications, which includes defining system requirements, designing the system's architecture, designing hardware, and implementing a sample test component of the system to evaluate its functionality. The BMS will calculate state of charge (SOC) and state of health (SOH) using various algorithms, which can be used to predict battery lifespan and maintenance schedules. A Bluetooth module will be installed to establish a connection between the battery and a mobile application that displays battery parameters, including SOC and SOH, and navigates the rider to the nearest charging station. Safety measures will be incorporated to protect the battery from potential issues. The rider can also use a navigation app to locate the closest charging station and feel less anxious when the battery drops below the charging limit.

articleTitle: Decentralized Finance and Cross-Chain Interoperable Automated Market Maker - Using BlockChain
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Emerging Trends in Information Technology and Engineering (ICETITE)
abstract: Decentralized Finance (DeFi) represents an alternative paradigm in financial infrastructure, operating a top the Ethereum Blockchain. DeFi leverages Automated Market Makers (AMMs) to facilitate the exchange of coins/tokens within Liquidity Pools (LPs). However, the current framework limits transactions to a single chain, resulting in prolonged processing times for cross-chain transactions. The principal drawbacks of existing AMMs include protracted transaction confirmation periods and constraints in single-chain functionality. This paper introduces Mixta, a web-based multi-chain interoperable AMM, aiming to address these limitations. Mixta empowers users to seamlessly exchange assets across different chains, ultimately reducing transaction confirmation times.

articleTitle: Ayurvedic Elixirs for Digital Generation Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Emerging Trends in Information Technology and Engineering (ICETITE)
abstract: To improve individualized healthcare, this study proposes an innovative Ayurvedic medication recommendation system that makes use of a knowledge graph structure. The system uses a knowledge graph to describe the complex connections between ailments and their accompanying medications, giving a thorough depiction of Ayurvedic therapeutic concepts. Users provide their exact disease as well as important details including age and pertinent health issues, such as diabetes, as well as their unique sickness. After that, the algorithm deftly eliminates medications that are incompatible with the specified demographic data, resulting in a personalized and secure suggestion. This system's use of the Hyperlink-Induced Topic Search (HITS) algorithm sets it apart from others. By carefully incorporating HITS, drugs are awarded authority and hub scores inside the knowledge graph, allowing the system to identify the most authoritative and influential treatments for a certain condition. To provide a tailored and effective suggestion process, medications are then offered to the user in a prioritized manner depending on their rankings. In addition to streamlining the selection process, this innovative method for recommending Ayurvedic medications also makes sure that the medicines match the user's unique health profile. Our approach provides a paradigm change in Ayurvedic healthcare by combining the strength of knowledge graphs with the accuracy of the HITS algorithm, opening the path for more efficient and customized treatment plans.

articleTitle: Beyond pH Levels: A Comprehensive Survey on Ocean Acidification
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Emerging Trends in Information Technology and Engineering (ICETITE)
abstract: This survey explores the transformative role of machine learning in addressing the pervasive threat of ocean acidification on marine ecosystems. Focusing on its predictive capabilities, the paper examines machine learning's efficacy in forecasting pH trends, pinpointing vulnerable species, and assessing broader ecosystem impacts. By training on historical data, machine learning models offer valuable insights for identifying at-risk regions, prioritizing conservation efforts, and optimizing fisheries management. The survey accentuates the integral role of machine learning in unraveling the complexities of ocean acidification while acknowledging challenges like data quality and model robustness. Beyond its theoretical implications, the paper underscores the pragmatic application of machine learning in formulating effective mitigation and adaptation strategies. In doing so, it not only advances understanding of ocean acidification but also sets a roadmap for future research, emphasizing the need for refined data, robust models, and seamless integration of research outcomes into practical solutions for marine ecosystem preservation. Keywords: machine learning, ocean acidification, pH trends, marine ecosystems, vulnerability assessment, conservation strategies, adaptation planning.

articleTitle: Adaptive Edge Computing for Autonomous Vehicles in Varying Environment
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Emerging Trends in Information Technology and Engineering (ICETITE)
abstract: This research offers an in-depth analysis of the integration of Autonomous Vehicle Platooning, Vehicle-to-Everything (V2X) communication, Edge Analytics, and Real-time Traffic Management. Central to the study is “Platooning,” where autonomous vehicles optimize road space, fuel efficiency, and safety. V2X communication, a silent yet critical interaction between vehicles and their surroundings, lays the foundation for advanced safety and navigation in autonomous vehicles. When combined with V2X, platooning generates vast data, making Edge Analytics essential for filtering realtime intelligence for swift decisions. The study emphasizes the importance of Real-time Traffic Management in managing urban congestion, with Edge Analytics providing dynamic route planning. By focusing on algorithms and practical applications, the research aims to merge these technologies for efficient, safe, and responsive Autonomous vehicles (AV) operations, offering insights for urban planning and traffic management, and setting the stage for a sustainable transportation future.

articleTitle: Gaze Corporate: A Corporate Profiling Website
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Emerging Trends in Information Technology and Engineering (ICETITE)
abstract: This paper addresses a critical gap in the existing literature by investigating trends in job-related searches over five years. To overcome this limitation, we introduce Gaze Corporate, a dedicated job-seeking website designed to help users achieve their objectives in finding positions. In this paper, we provide an overview of our methodology, which leverages the capabilities of Gaze Corporate to comprehensively analyze trends and patterns among various companies, categorized by their primary industry. Our analysis incorporates employee ratings and reviews to discern evolving trends in job searches and keyword usage over time. The implications of our findings are discussed, offering valuable insights for both job seekers and investors interested in understanding and evaluating companies. Gaze Corporate emerges as a powerful tool for profiling corporations, shedding light on dynamic trends within the job market and providing strategic information for individuals and investors alike. As the digital era continues to shape the employment landscape, our research positions Gaze Corporate as an indispensable resource for those seeking to navigate and understand the intricate interplay between job searches, corporate trends, and investment decisions.

articleTitle: A Fruit and Vegetable Detection Based on Pytorch Machine Learning Frame Work Model
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Emerging Trends in Information Technology and Engineering (ICETITE)
abstract: Today, Agricultures has become a significant element of people's life. Among them fruits and vegetables are a great thing for healthy lives. Classification of fruits and vegetable are difficult for normal person because of some same similarities like shape and color. Also, Fruits and Vegetables classification is an important process in industries applications as well as local market. Lots of similarities available between fruits like apples, pears and peaches, and that kinds of fruits are generally used in daily routine. As well as some vegetables are same in shape, so it will be difficult to differentiate in this type of situation for old persons. The previous research for solution of this type of problem for classification of fruits CNN is used but the problem in this research is when they use the self-made datasets then their accuracy decreases as compare to public datasets accuracy increases. To solve this type of problem, here produce a kind of algorithms in the paper to classify fruits and vegetable, using deep leaning technique such as VGG16 and DenseNet169 model have capability to extract the feature of images very deeply using various small filters so it provide a better result. On this premise, it was used to classify fruit kinds against a complex background and integrated with data improvement technology for future usage. It might be helpful for human for automatic differentiate the both categories. This project is implemented in the python programming language and the dataset used Fruits and Vegetables Image Recognition Dataset for the classification. Which will help to differentiate between Fruits and Vegetables with high accuracy rate. For the implementation of this project used Python programming and this implementation using the tool like Jupiter and Kaggle Notebook and used GPU for highspeed execution.

articleTitle: SCSYGPS: Students Course-Wise, Semester-Wise and Year-Wise Grade Prediction System in Education Sector Using Supervised Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Emerging Trends in Information Technology and Engineering (ICETITE)
abstract: Educational Data Mining (EDM) is the research field that deals with the application of Data Mining techniques on the data obtained from education sector. Predicting students' academic performance is of paramount importance to students, instructor, and educational institutes. In this research article, a framework for prediction of students' performance in particular course, semester and year is developed and named it as S<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">CSY</inf>GPS (Students' Course-wise, Semester-wise, and Year-wise Grade Prediction System). In this framework, data is collected from university result ledgers related to four year Computer Science and Engineering Programme and prepared nine datasets. Eight classification algorithms - Random Forests (RF), Linear Support Vector Classifier (LSVC), Gradient Boosting (GB), K-Nearest Neighbour (KNN), AdaBoost, XGBoost, LightGBM, and Linear Discriminannt Analysis (LDA) are applied one by one on nine datasets. The classification algorithm that works best for each dataset is selected based on performance parameters values such as Accuracy, F1-Score, Precision, Recall, and Mean Absolute Error (MAE). The classification algorithm which has the highest value of performance parameters accuracy, f1-score, precision, recall, and lowest value of MAE is considered as the best classification algorithm for that dataset. For seven datasets, LightGBM is found to be the best classification algorithm while XGBoost and AdaBoost is noted to be the best classification algorithms for two datasets with accuracy 97% nd 95% respectively.

articleTitle: Strategic Synergy: Role of Game Theory in Neural Networks and Telecom Sector
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Emerging Trends in Information Technology and Engineering (ICETITE)
abstract: Present study explores the application of game theory principles in neural networks by focusing on strategic decision-making within Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) and the strategic acumen of Recurrent Neural Networks(RNNs). Neural networks, renowned for exceptional performance in visual recognition and unsupervised learning, offer a foundational context for deciphering complex decision making processes across various domains. Transitioning seamlessly, most of the inquiry extends to the dynamic landscape of the Indian telecom sector. Present article scrutinizes the transformative influence of Reliance Jio by employing game theory concepts such as zero-sum games and strategic dynamics and by providing nuanced insights into Jio's market dominance and its repercussions on existing players. Within the telecom sector, present study dissects strategic manoeuvres which emphasize hybrid strategies, market share dynamics, and the temporal evolution of strategies. This interdisciplinary exploration not only illuminates the practical implications of game theory but also highlights its role in shaping strategic decisions, market dynamics, and learning processes within both neural networks and the telecom industry.

articleTitle: Proof-of-Concept Translator Using AI: Ecuadorian Sign Language to Human Voice App
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Emerging Trends in Information Technology and Engineering (ICETITE)
abstract: The main purpose of this study is to propose a High-Level Design capable of recognize Ecuadorian Sign Language through data processing with Convolution Neural Networks (CNN) and later, for its subsequent audible translation into Spanish language using functional components of speech synthesis from text. With the purpose of guaranteeing optimal and reliable responses in data transmission, the application of Edge Computing App is chosen as onsite data processing strategy but reflecting the image analysis in Cloud Database using MQTT as data transport and Image Mining for granular image classification on identification stages.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of SEPIC Converter for Wind Energy System
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Emerging Trends in Information Technology and Engineering (ICETITE)
abstract: The SEPIC (Single-Ended Primary-Inductor Converter) is a type of DC-DC converter that is specifically designed to manage the output voltage of a power source. The SEPIC converter may adjust the voltage of the DC power supply while maintaining a consistent output voltage. This function is likewise served by the buck boost converter, but because of its inverted output, a positive input voltage will result in a negative output voltage. A customized converter called a sepic converter is utilized to get around the buck boost's downside. The advantage of generating the non-inverting output is provided by the addition of an additional inductor at the source side. The output of a SEPIC converter is managed in a closed loop by means of feedback control. By comparing the feedback signal with the reference voltage, the comparator generates the error signal. To manage the output voltage, the feedback controller changes the duty cycle of the PWM controller after receiving this error signal. Our project's SEPIC converter has closed-loop control, and the user can manually change the set voltage to suit their typical load requirements. Following measurement, the manually preset voltage is compared to the load's output voltage by the dSPIC controller. By using PI gains to reduce error and adjusting duty cycle, the controller may obtain the set voltage that will be the load's output voltage. The error signal is derived from the compared value. The PWM signals needed to switch the MOSFET are produced by the controller. The TLP250 opto driver IC circuit is used to switch the MOSFET in accordance with the PWM signals since the PWM signals cannot be used directly for MOSFET switching. The hardware includes output terminals to connect the converter's output to other loads or circuits. The load has a resistance of one kilo ohm. Every time the specified voltage is altered, this process is started over. In a closed loop voltage control, 40 volts is the most voltage that can be controlled, and 3 volts is the lowest voltage that can be controlled. The buck or boost mode of operation, along with the actual voltage and the set voltage, are all presented on the LCD display.

articleTitle: Crop Yield Prediction Using Machine Learning Techniques Based on Soil and Environment Traits – A Survey
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Emerging Trends in Information Technology and Engineering (ICETITE)
abstract: In research, the examination of agriculture is increasing rapidly. Crop yield prediction is an important aspect in agriculture. In earlier days, farmers get good yielding. Due to the inefficiency in soil nutrients level and climatic changes crop yield level decreasing day by day. Hence, estimating the production is a crucial role in agriculture area also it helps to farmer for storing and marketing their yielded products. For predicting the precise agricultural yield, a variety of techniques, including remote sensing and machine learning, are used. This paper discussed a number of strategies for predicting crop yields that had been used by various researchers. In accordance to this review, the deployment of machine learning in agriculture indicates more effective and precise farming with fewer human assistance, as well as higher quality goods.

articleTitle: Enhancing Artwork Resilience Through Variable Embedding Technique
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Emerging Trends in Information Technology and Engineering (ICETITE)
abstract: In the rapidly evolving digital world, safeguarding creative works against unapproved modifications has emerged as a critical issue. Because of the shortcomings of traditional procedures, stronger solutions are being studied. The study uses a novel application of variable embedding technology to address the important problem of maintaining copyright integrity for digital artwork. This paper provides a systematic analysis of the method's effectiveness and a detailed understanding of how appropriate it is to certain image characteristics. And, the paper has illustrated the method's resistance to possible attacks by in-depth experimental investigations, offering a viable path for protecting copyrighted digital art. This study intends to add to the discussion about enhancing authenticity and data protection in the field of artistic expression as the world of digital media expands further.

articleTitle: Virtual Reality-Based Training Simulator for Robot-Assisted Surgery Using Unity and 3D Slicer
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Emerging Trends in Information Technology and Engineering (ICETITE)
abstract: Robotic interventions have become a pivotal component in minimally invasive neurosurgical procedures. While the use of robotic devices in medical operations is advancing, there is still a pressing need to train and equip medical professionals with emerging biomedical developments. Though Virtual reality (VR) has been proven to be a great tool for embodied learning, existing studies demonstrate a lack of interactive open-source platforms for medical interventions. Addressing this need for robot-assisted surgery (RAS) skills acquisition task, we propose a heuristic learning scheme in a simulator encompassing cross-platform registration tasks to train individuals for a typical image-guided surgery (IGS) procedure. The proposed training simulator offers an interactive, risk-free, cost-effective, and efficient learning platform for acquiring RAS skills both in Desktop VR and Head Mounted Display (HMD) VR settings. This training module provides a workflow for patient registration between the simulated robotic coordinate space in Unity 3D, and the IGS coordinate space in 3D slicer. The simulator's interface provides a user-friendly training environment with realtime instructions as well as visual and tactile feedback. A data collection scheme is also presented for a comparative user study of the learning experiences between HMD and desktop VR-based learning settings. This work showcases the efficacy of RAS training platform in performing cross-platform fiducial registration with an RMSE of 1.34 mm (in Desktop VR) and 1.49 mm (in HMD settings).

articleTitle: Convolutional Neural Network Hardware Optimization Using Bayesian Method
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Emerging Trends in Information Technology and Engineering (ICETITE)
abstract: Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) models have demonstrated significant benefits in the realm of computer vision and applications related to image processing. Optimizing hyperparameters in CNN models is crucial to ensuring an effective implementation of the model, whether on software, hardware, or a ‘software-hardware co-design’ platform, thereby enhancing overall performance and results. This work proposes a CNN architecture and applies the Bayesian optimization algorithm to find the best set of hyperparameter values which reduces training and recognition time both. In addition, a new parameter i.e., ‘Network optimization parameter’ (NOP) is defined which considers optimization of hardware resources for a given accuracy of the trained model. This parameter needs to be minimized which helps evaluate the best set of hyperparameter values and is essential for further implementing the CNN model in the hardware platform. The optimization is performed on both the processors, a Central Processing Unit (CPU) and a Graphical Processing Unit (GPU), in optimizing the CNN model to clearly understand the impacts of utilizing different processing units. An accuracy of 99.48 % is achieved for the Modified National Institute of Standards and Technology (MNIST) database, and an accuracy of 88.78 % is achieved for the Canadian Institute For Advanced Research (CIFAR-10) database. The proposed models are highly optimized and have lesser resource requirements (due to the lesser layer complexities and smaller filter sizes) while delivering higher accuracies compared to the available literature. Further, the calculated NOP for the proposed network is highly reduced compared to the published literature.

articleTitle: Analyzing Computational Performance of Blockchain and Internet of Things in Healthcare
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Emerging Trends in Information Technology and Engineering (ICETITE)
abstract: In recent years, blockchain networks have expanded their relevance beyond cryptocurrency applications. The integration of blockchain and the Internet of Things (IoT) has gained considerable attention. This merge leverages blockchain's features, such as decentralization, immutability, and traceability to bolster IoT system security, introducing the concept of “BIo'T.” This paper offers an updated review of blockchain technology's recent advancements and its wide-ranging applications. It starts with a primer on blockchain and IoT, highlighting their real-world implementations. The paper also explores ongoing work within data security, with a focus on healthcare systems where blockchain plays a vital role. The critical assessment of the current state of blockchain technology is made by emphasizing its computational speed, which is particularly pertinent in healthcare applications, where efficiency is crucial. In conclusion, the paper not only summarizes the current landscape but also identifies research challenges and future directions to encourage further exploration in this promising field.

articleTitle: A Hybrid Approach for Inventory Price Estimation Based on Sentiment and Technical Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Emerging Trends in Information Technology and Engineering (ICETITE)
abstract: Recent years have seen significant studies into applying machine learning techniques for stock price prediction. However, most existing work in this field focuses on examining historical stock price data for forecasting stock prices, ignoring the role of public sentiments and mood on the stock market. In this work, a new approach is introduced that considers the sentiment factor along with the historical stock price to increase the precision of stock price forecasting. The proposed system includes a deep neural network that takes historical stock price information and sentiment analysis of news headlines as input characteristics. The system evaluates the framework's performance using the dataset of news headlines and stock prices of six different industries. There currently needs to be more literature in the field of stock price prediction, which incorporates both historical stock price data and sentimental data. Hence, the proposed hybrid approach for stock price prediction using sentiment and technical analysis significantly contributes to estimating the stock price.

articleTitle: Enhancing Security with Microcontroller-Based Face Detection in Sensitive Environments
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Emerging Trends in Information Technology and Engineering (ICETITE)
abstract: This paper describes the design and development of an Arduino-powered face identification and tracking robot that is lightweight, affordable, and highly effective. The project aimed to implement face detection using a mobile camera that moves along with the face with the help of servo motors. The application was built using android processing and it uses Bluetooth connectivity to connect with the Arduino board to change the positions and dimensions of camera angles. The system showed that, in appropriate illumination circumstances, its face detection system could successfully identify and track faces using the Viola-Jones algorithm. A key element of the system was the Tilt and Robotic Arm, which allowed the camera module to be adjusted in present-time to maintain the face centered of the video stream. It has potential to be used in human-computer interface systems, security and surveillance systems, and systems for detecting sleepy drivers using this technology. Future plans include expanding the functionality of the robot by adding facial recognition technology and improving the robustness and reliability of the system by optimizing the detection and tracking algorithms and using more advanced hardware components. Overall, the project demonstrates the potential of face detection and tracking robots for revolutionizing the way we interact with technology and each other.

articleTitle: Single Image Dehazing using a Channel and Pixel Attention Network
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Emerging Trends in Information Technology and Engineering (ICETITE)
abstract: In this work, a novel feature focus network is proposed to recover image information lost due to fog in an image. The network architecture can be divided into three main categories: 1) A feature attention block that combines the channel and pixel attention layers of the neural network to decompose images. Different channels of the image carry different weighted information about the intensity of fog at each pixel in the image. Considering this fact, this network provides additional robustness when trying to decompose images by treating different features and pixels differently. 2) The underlying structure of this network comprises feature attention and residual learning. Residual learning is used as a solution to the vanishing gradient problem faced by deep neural networks. It has now become one of the basic requirements of deep neural network. 3) Feature weights in this network are learned to prioritize salient features and adapt from the feature focus module. The proposed network outperforms previous dehazing methods in terms of structural similarity index and peak signal-to-noise ratio, as demonstrated by experimental results.

articleTitle: Detection and Categorization of Conflict Flows Within SDN Environments using Machine Learning Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Emerging Trends in Information Technology and Engineering (ICETITE)
abstract: Software-Defined Networking (SDN) is known for its remarkable versatility and adaptability. SDN applications encompass a wide range of network management and control functionalities, including load balancing, access control, and routing. However, SDN can encounter issues stemming from conflicting traffic patterns that may degrade network performance in relation of efficiency and optimization. These conflicts arise when factors such as priority and action settings are adjusted. Furthermore, IP spoofing, commonly employed for anonymity and amplification, frequently leads to widespread distributed denial-of-service (DDoS) attacks. We've established a sufficient condition based on the duration and frequency of DDoS attacks. Notably, our sophisticated attack method generates legitimate traffic within the SIP network using reflection techniques. “As a result, it has the ability to bypass security measures such as blacklists, IP blocking, rate limiting based on packet counts or session/transaction volumes, and automated systems designed to detect unnatural message generation. These security mechanisms are commonly employed in advanced security setups, but the system or technique in question can effectively avoid detection or restriction when interacting with digital environments.”

articleTitle: Phase-Locked Loop (PLL) Techniques for Grid Synchronization: A Comprehensive Review
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Emerging Trends in Information Technology and Engineering (ICETITE)
abstract: The increasing penetration of renewable energy into the grid necessitates the employment of grid synchronization techniques to ensure proper integration and stability of the system. Several grid synchronization techniques are available, among which the Phase Locked Loop(PLL) method has proven to be the more employed one owing to its simplicity and robustness. Despite being able to provide effective operation of the system under variable grid conditions this technique faces certain technological challenges. This paper studies, in detail, the various PLL techniques that are implemented in the Renewable Energy Sector(RES) such as Synchronous Reference Frame (SRF PLL), Decoupled Double Synchronous Reference Frame (DDSRF PLL), Enhanced Phase Locked Loop (EPLL), and Dual Second Order General Integrator (DSOGI PLL). The different techniques of the PLL are compared and analyzed based on their efficiency, response to voltage and frequency deviations, complexity, and stability. SRF PLL gives excellent response under balanced grid conditions, but EPLL, FLL and SOGI based PLLs are more efficient to address unbalanced grid conditions. The limitations of the PLL technique such as reduced stability margin and manufacturing costs, has lead to the development of improved and new PLLs, which are under research.

articleTitle: Natural Language Translation Engine For Announcements and Information Dissemination At Stations
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Emerging Trends in Information Technology and Engineering (ICETITE)
abstract: In today's fast-paced global travel landscape, effective communication is crucial, especially in dynamic environments like railway stations. This research paper addresses linguistic diversity challenges by developing a cutting-edge natural language translation engine tailored for railway communication. It integrates advanced technologies such as Transformer-based Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) with noise reduction algorithms like Wav2Vec 2.0 and an Attention-based Convolutional Recurrent Neural Network (CRNN) to overcome background noise and diverse speech patterns. The system also includes multilingual Text-to-Speech (TTS) and Machine Translation (MT) capabilities for clear communication in real-time across multiple languages. Interactive features like a responsive Chatbot and Interactive Voice Response System (IVRS) enhance user engagement. This approach meets passengers' linguistic needs while promoting inclusivity. Technically, the project explores algorithms like the Transformer model, positional encoding, self-attention mechanisms, and feed-forward neural networks. The research aims to revolutionize railway communication and establish a precedent for technology-driven public transportation, creating universally accessible and user-friendly travel experiences.

articleTitle: Leveraging Data Analytics in Azure for Effective Churn Management
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Emerging Trends in Information Technology and Engineering (ICETITE)
abstract: This research aims to develop optimized and cost-effective Azure architecture solutions by strategically selecting and utilizing Microsoft Azure services for specific use cases. The study leverages a simulated data-driven churn management case study within a social network context, emulating real-world data scenarios. The methodology employed involves a comprehensive understanding of the existing churn management script, enabling adaptability to diverse scenarios. This necessitates an in-depth exploration of Microsoft Azure's service offerings to ascertain their necessity and relevance. As the case study entails real-time streaming of event data, it is channeled into a staging area while concurrently undergoing batch processing for both account and subscription data. This synthesis culminates in a unified storage space tailored for analytics purposes. The implications of this research are twofold. First, the study yields a high-impact automated asset from a business standpoint. Second, it contributes expertise in the intricate process of migrating an entire asset from on-premises infrastructure to the cloud. Furthermore, using streamlined cost optimization achieved by judiciously selecting and configuring only essential resources, culminating in efficient outcomes. This paves the way for client-side stakeholders to make informed, data-driven decisions, leveraging the insights harnessed from the system.
