Code examples for processing data and machine learning model implementation are included in the research, together with the compilation and labelling of an extensive dataset. The findings and outcomes from the tests on disease classification are carefully explained. Accompanying them is a comprehensive examination of the assessment metrics, encompassing ROC curves, cross-validation outcomes, recall, accuracy, and a F1 score. These results not only highlight the effectiveness of the suggested methodology but also provide a comparative evaluation of various models and techniques. The study's comparison assessment and investigation findings highlight the possibility for more precise and scalable illness detection methods, providing a foundation for further research in this area.

articleTitle: Development of a Mouse for Individuals Without Upper Limbs Using Arduino Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Emerging Trends in Information Technology and Engineering (ICETITE)
abstract: This project centers around creating a prototype mouse utilizing the Arduino platform, aimed at enhancing computer accessibility for individuals lacking upper limb mobility. The prototype comprises a microcontroller responsible for processing signals from the MPU-6050 sensor, used as a reference for cursor position, and foot-operated buttons for right and left-click functions. Its design enables cursor control through head movements, providing users with an easy and intuitive way to interact with the computer's graphical interface. Feasibility testing was conducted through experimental trials, resulting in ideal accuracy and precision. These trials indicate that the device is viable for use in individuals without upper limbs.

articleTitle: Zigbee Communication Protocol for Cansat Telemetry and Control
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Emerging Trends in Information Technology and Engineering (ICETITE)
abstract: Communication plays a significant role in the trans- mission of information from one point to another. Usually, to ensure efficient communication between the transmitter and receiver various parameters are considered like power requirements, range, data rate, and so on. For small-range applications and small satellite applications like Cansat, it is often challenging to select a communication protocol for the transmission of information. Zigbee protocol is one such communication protocol that can be implemented as it provides an efficient solution for the project requirements. Zigbee protocol is considered to offer a decent data rate along with minimal power requirements making it a popular choice for IOT applications as well as other small-scale project requirements. This work showcases the implementation of the Zigbee protocol for establishing a telemetry link for Cansat.

articleTitle: Implementation of Neural Network Based Digital Pre-distorter for Power Amplifier Linearisation
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Emerging Trends in Information Technology and Engineering (ICETITE)
abstract: Digital pre-distortion refers to the use of digital signal processing to address nonlinearities caused by an analog RF front-end in a wireless transmitter. These nonlinearities can lead to nearby channel interference, reduce the transmitted signal's error vector magnitude, and often require the transmitter to operate at a less efficient but more linear region of the device. This work aims to implement a neural network-based digital predistortion algorithm. This pre-distortion algorithm is modelled using a time-delay kernel ridge regression (KRR) algorithm. This is an advanced machine-learning algorithm that considers memory effects. Both software and hardware platforms have been used for this application to produce effective results and discover a comparative comparison between the performance of software and hardware based on some parameters like accuracy, resource utilization, and operation frequency. The training and testing data of an already existing, simulated model is taken, and hardware implementation for the same is carried out using the Verilog HDL programming using the Xilinx Vivado tool.

articleTitle: Effective Categorization of Lung Abnormalities using Squeezenet Features and Machine Learning Models
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Emerging Trends in Information Technology and Engineering (ICETITE)
abstract: Lung cancer is the primary cause of cancer-related fatalities in the developed countries. This is due to the changes in lifestyle of the peple and also it is clinically evident only after progressing to advanced stages. Therefore, early detection of lung cancer is essential for patient survival. X-ray, computer tomography and magnetic resonance imaging approaches are used to detect the lung cancer. In this study, it is aimed to develop CAD system to classify the different types of lung cancers using histopathological images. Deep learning techniques are widely used techniques in the medical image classification. Results show that logistic regression is found to achieve an accuracy of 96% in differentiating the tumor cells. High value of 94% for MCC clearly indicates that the features extracted using squeezenet features has the ability to categorize abnormality. SVM with RBF kernel displays better peformance in identifying the categories of tumor with an accuracy of 89.8%. k-NN model with by distance weights is found to show comparatively high peformance in detecting the abnormalities in the images with accuracy and AUC values of 98.4% and 99.8% respectively. This study is among the few studies which has achieved significant performance for multiclass classification.

articleTitle: Revolutionizing Security Measures for Enhanced Perimeter Protection and Intrusion Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Emerging Trends in Information Technology and Engineering (ICETITE)
abstract: The Revolutionizing Security Measures for Enhanced Perimeter Protection and Intrusion Detection project has developed an advanced laser-based security system designed to detect intrusions accurately and provide timely alerts. This system employs a network of strategically positioned laser beams and detectors to create a protective grid, acting as virtual barriers that trigger alarms when disrupted. The hardware and software components, including laser emitters, photodetectors, and Arduino, are combined to form a highly precise and customizable security solution. Performance evaluation includes testing for detection accuracy, false alarm rates, response time, robustness to environmental factors, user interface usability, power efficiency, and cost-effectiveness. The results indicate that the system excels in enhancing security, accuracy, prompt response, and resilience in various conditions, while also being user-friendly and cost-effective. This innovative laser security system integrates seamlessly with existing security technologies and can be easily expanded and adapted to different security requirements, making it a valuable investment for enhanced safety and asset protection.

articleTitle: Detecting Fish Species Through Mask RCNN
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Emerging Trends in Information Technology and Engineering (ICETITE)
abstract: Detection of underwater fish species has become more important through marine science research. Automatic detection of fish species would facilitate the development of marine science. There are several different methods that can be employed to determine fish species. Each of the available methods requires a substantial amount of training data to detect precisely. To overcome this, in this article, we report on the findings of an investigation that was carried out utilizing an deep learning algorithm known as Mask Region based Convolution Neural Network (RCNN). The investigation was conducted using a dataset containing images of various types and directions of fish found in different parts of the world. Mask RCNN is able to produce the highest quality segmentation mask possible for every occurrence and different fish species with a high degree of accuracy. The mask RCNN is able to recognize and categorize fish species with an overall accuracy of almost 97%.

articleTitle: Analysis of Various Types of Battery Systems On APU for More Electric Aircraft
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Emerging Trends in Information Technology and Engineering (ICETITE)
abstract: In aviations the major challenge is to tackle the environmental effects on fuel consumption and emission, mainly nitric oxide which is harmful for environment which results in Acid rain, photochemical smog etc.. The development of electric power sources which is based upon non-polluting fuel is based on open research direction to meet the goals, fuel cells containing H2 are one such possibility. The goal is to lessen the environmental effect on both aerodrome and aboard equipment. The MEA idea aims to substitute electrical energy for nonelectric power. Military aircraft were the first to use this concept. The question of applying this idea to civil airplanes has come up throughout time. Power electronics have advanced quickly, allowing for flexible electricity transfer from sources to loads. The electrical system uses power electronics for power delivery, conversion, and generation. Obtaining increasingly efficient subsystems and integrating them into the aircraft's energy system is the trend in the building of such intricate electrical power systems on airplanes. This can shorten the time and lower the cost of design. In this paper the analysis and simulation of an APU- auxiliary power source is proposed in this work. The analysis has been done for different cases such as the whole APU system works on Fuelcell, based on Li-on Battery and fuel cell+Li-ion battery case, the whole analysis has been done using MATLAB Simulink. The converter system, which modifies the energy sources' properties to meet the needs of the MEA-type aircraft's power users, is given special consideration.

articleTitle: Agribot: An IoT and Deep Learning-Based System Empowering Precision Farming
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Emerging Trends in Information Technology and Engineering (ICETITE)
abstract: Farmers frequently encounter issues such as irregular weather patterns and ineffective resource management, particularly in irrigation practices. Offering them a centralized information platform equipped with vital data for monitoring and managing their fields has the potential to be a game changer. This paper describes an advanced smart agricultural system that combines both cutting-edge software and hardware modules to transform current farming practices. The hardware components, which include data collecting and soil quality assessment sensors, work together with machine learning models to provide accurate weather forecasts and crop recommendations. Our technology offers a high degree of precision in predicting and advising suitable crop choices based on real-time soil conditions by utilizing closely trained models. The user-friendly online interface offers safe authentication mechanisms, complete irrigation status updates, and crop-specific information. The system's distinctive strength comes in its ability to handle soil data, allowing it to provide individualized crop suggestions and exact planting directions. This research not only provides farmers with actionable knowledge but also represents a big step toward more sustainable and efficient farming practices. The study finishes with suggestions for potential future refinement avenues, highlighting the ongoing commitment to enhancing precision farming technologies.

articleTitle: Review on IOMT Security through Distributed Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Emerging Trends in Information Technology and Engineering (ICETITE)
abstract: In this constructive healthcare industry, AI-based IOMT (Internet of Medical Things) is one of the highly used Technologies. The virtual world is customary to lose responsible data in cyberspace. Without any doubt, IOMT comes under this category. IOMT applications do not intensively focus on Security and privacy and it is a Serious downside of IOMT applications. Considering this crucial issue, we use the Multiple-node machine learning Technique. It is widely used for preserving the privacy of the huge records. It does not want to share its sensitive data from one node to another node, which result in providing security and privacy to medical record by adding protection to input records, output tags, parameters, etc. This paper exclusively focuses on the Security and Privacy of Medical Records and also shows the various roles of Distributed Machine Learning.

articleTitle: Python Based Analysis For Customer Issue Resolution Using CMT App Device Logs
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Emerging Trends in Information Technology and Engineering (ICETITE)
abstract: Cambridge Mobile Telematics (CMT) is the world's biggest telematics specialist organization. The organization's AI-driven stage accumulates sensor information from several IoT gadgets including cell phones, exclusive Tags, associated vehicles, dashcams, and outsider gadgets and combines them with contextual information. Thanks to the heterogeneity of components, manufacturers, and evolution of underlying firmware. Creating logs is one of the strategies for recording the operating events, which has variety of file structures and due to the lack of standardization of log syntax, analysing of these files is complex for manual processing. The Support Team must analyse the Device logs to Give a solution for the issues raised by the CMT cus-tomers. CMT customers face two significant issues; one is related to the Tag linking Issue that is specific to the App Plus Tag Program, and the other is regarding the Trip Recording Issue, which is typical for both the App-only Program and App Plus Tag Program. Pattern Detection using Python is one of the best approaches for better detection and classification of data from device logs. Two different pattern detection utilities were developed, which gives the detailed explanation of the workflow and can also serve as a support for: tracking the necessary Patterns, Storing the process of different functional patterns, method of data(patterns) extraction and the output formatting of issues with the solution. In this paper, pattern extraction is done using python programming language, and the output will contain the problem statement with solution in various formats like JSON and CSV.

articleTitle: Smart Waste Bins using DCNN and Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Emerging Trends in Information Technology and Engineering (ICETITE)
abstract: Waste sorting poses significant challenges because of several factors, including a lack of awareness and education about proper disposal, inadequate infrastructure and collection systems, cultural practices that discourage segregation, economic factors without financial incentives, confusion due to the absence of clear guidelines and regulations for waste sorting, and time and convenience constraints. These challenges give rise to various health issues. Improper waste disposal can result in the spread of diseases through pests and rodents. Burning or burying mixed waste releases pollutants that can lead to respiratory problems. Hazardous waste, when not correctly separated, can contaminate groundwater, and unsorted waste may pose injury risks for waste workers and scavengers, including sharp objects and hazardous materials. In our study, we present a smart waste segregation system and describe the development of an intelligent waste bin designed to categorize deposited waste into various groups according to its nature, spanning from household-level waste to municipal-level waste.. This smart waste bin employs Deep Convolutional Neural Networks (DCNN) to sort the waste and incorporates ultrasonic sensors, moisture sensors, and rotary actuators. This integration enables the efficient sorting and segregation of waste placed into the smart waste bin. Combining the DCNN with actuators and sensors enhances the effectiveness of waste sorting. The implementation of these sensors will be carried out using Arduino UNO R3 and the ESP32 Camera Module

articleTitle: Medical Image Video Watermarking Using Deep Neural Network Technique
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Emerging Trends in Information Technology and Engineering (ICETITE)
abstract: A new technique of watermarking for medical data protection using a neural network is explained in this research. The neural network is used in conjunction with the Levenberg-Marquard method to enhance the control of watermarking strength as well as the performance of traditional watermarking techniques. When compared to earlier data security solutions, the simulation results show that the suggested scheme is more effective. Our approaches for measuring gait pathology with common cameras make quantitative motion estimation more accessible in hospitals and at home, allowing researchers to perform large-scale investigations of musculoskeletal and neurological problems. Digital watermarking has been extensively researched as a way of preserving the intellectual property rights of high-value-added digital photographs. Machine learning and Deep Neural Network (DNN) have recently driven us to robust applications in the huge advancement of Artificial Intelligence. Trained DNN models have made it simple for researchers to achieve state-of-the-art findings. However, distributing these trained models is always a difficult process, especially in terms of security and protection. This paper suggests a DNN model for digital watermarking that examines Deep Neural Network intellectual property, embedding watermarks, and owner verification. This model can generate watermarks to protect against potential attacks (fine-tuning and train to embed). The standard dataset is used to test this method. As a result, this model is resistant to counter-watermark attacks. Our approach checks the ownership of all remotely extended deep learning models reliably and promptly without altering the model's accuracy for standard information inputs. Digital information may now be easily changed, copied, distributed, and stored, resulting in secure information ownership.

articleTitle: Phishion: Phishing Detection Application
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Emerging Trends in Information Technology and Engineering (ICETITE)
abstract: The threat posed by phishing websites is significant in the digital era due to the widespread use of online activities, which has prompted the need for a comprehensive remedy. The project involves building a website that acts as a database for information about phishing URLs, along with retrieving domain details for in-depth examination. Users will be able to contribute and retrieve phishing data, encouraging teamwork and alertness. In addition, a specialized Chrome extension will provide real-time detection of phishing websites with the support of machine learning techniques and pattern matching. In response to the growing demand for a secure online environment, this effort works as a cohesive ecosystem to protect online users by gathering important data and actively alerting them, when possible, dangers are detected.

articleTitle: Competitive Sentiment Analysis for Brand Reputation Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Emerging Trends in Information Technology and Engineering (ICETITE)
abstract: In a world characterized by rapid information sharing and constant consumer feedback, the ability of brands to understand and respond to changing public sentiment is crucial. The proposed research responds to the imperative of comprehending public sentiment regarding brands relative to their competitors. It aims to not only track how people feel about a brand but also provide valuable insights by comparing it to how they feel about similar brands in the market. The proposed research incorporates Information retrieval techniques such as Textual Similarity calculation to compare textual data and Machine Learning techniques to compare product similarity for Competitive Analysis. We aim to create user-friendly visualizations and tools to help brands stay up-to-date with public opinion, empowering them to make informed decisions in an ever-evolving landscape of consumer sentiment and competition. This research aims to offer a practical solution for brand reputation management and market research strategy in the digital age.

articleTitle: Optimizing Tandem Solar Cell Efficiency: A Perovskite-CIGS Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Emerging Trends in Information Technology and Engineering (ICETITE)
abstract: Tandem solar cells combining perovskite and CIGS have rapidly gained prominence as highly efficient photovoltaic devices. Recent advancements in enhancing their efficiency in-volve adjusting the thickness of distinct layers with tunable bandgaps, demonstrating superior performance compared to al-ternative tandem solar cells. The upper cell, employing perovskite material chosen for its excellent light absorption coefficient and optoelectronic properties, collaborates with the bottom CIGS cell, characterized by a tunable bandgap and low thermal requirements, contributing significantly to overall efficiency improvement. Through numerical simulations conducted with wxAMPS software, our proposed model, which incorporates a 3μm thick perovskite absorber layer as the upper cell and a 3.5μm thick CIGS absorber layer as the lower cell, demonstrated outstanding power conversion efficiency of 40.0209%, Voc of 1.8675 V, Jsc of 23.2146 mA/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>, and FF of 92.3152

articleTitle: A Survey on Tea Plant Disease Prediction for Blister Blight
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Emerging Trends in Information Technology and Engineering (ICETITE)
abstract: This survey seeks to give a general overview of the current state of Tea Plant disease prediction for the Blister Blight disease. To construct this system, IoT and machine learning approaches are applied. The goal of the research is to improve sustainable farming methods through early detection and prevention. The climatic conditions of the farmlands are analysed with a set of sensors. Real time input from the IoT setup is processed by the Machine Learning algorithms for detection of the Blister Blight disease.

articleTitle: Study of Ocean Pattern's and Ocean Bed Using Applications of IOT
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Emerging Trends in Information Technology and Engineering (ICETITE)
abstract: The ocean plays an integral role for influencing Earth's climate and sustaining diverse ecosystems as oceans covers almost 70 % of the earth's surface. It is important to monitor and control the ocean biodiversity through the advanced IoT technologies. The internet of Underwater things (IoUT) is an emerging technology which can connect the underwater objects as well as environment. IoUT is directly related with the navigation, disaster prediction, smart monitoring and intelligent system. Understanding the dynamics of the ocean is crucial for various applications, including weather forecasting, maritime operations, and environmental conservation. This research paper presents an in-depth analysis of an Ocean buoy Monitoring System that utilizes temperature, humidity, and geolocation data collected from buoys to predict ocean patterns, tides, and marine life. The system combines real-time sensor measurements with advanced data analysis techniques to provide valuable insights into oceanographic phenomena.

articleTitle: Horn Detection System for Four-Wheeler Using Arduino
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Emerging Trends in Information Technology and Engineering (ICETITE)
abstract: Road transportation is a vital mode of transportation for people to travel long distances and commute to work. Horns are used as a warning signal to alert other drivers about danger or indicate other vehicles presence. However, there are many reasons why a driver may not be able to hear a horn, such as background noise, hearing impairment, weather conditions, or the use of headphones. This can lead to accidents and traffic congestion. A horn detection device (HDD) is a system that can help drivers with hearing impairment to detect horns. HDD uses ultrasonic sensors and a microphone to detect the sound of a horn. When a horn is detected, HDD will alert the driver with a visual or auditory signal. HDD is a simple and effective way to improve road safety for drivers with hearing impairment. The system is easy to install and can be used in any vehicle. HDD is also affordable and can be a valuable investment for drivers who are concerned about their safety. When a horn is detected, HDD will send an alert to the driver. The alert can be a visual signal, such as a light on the dashboard or an auditory signal, such as a beep. The driver can then take appropriate action, such as slowing down or changing lanes. HDD is a valuable safety device for drivers with hearing impairment. The system is easy to install and use. It can help to prevent accidents and traffic congestion and also gives flexibility for deaf persons to detect horns.

articleTitle: A Critical Overview on Technological Progress in Nanosheets
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Emerging Trends in Information Technology and Engineering (ICETITE)
abstract: Nanosheet FET is the advanced semiconductor device in VLSI. For below 5nm node, Nanosheet FET providing excellent ON current, gate control over the channel, reduced power dissipation and high performance compared with FinFET and Nanowire FET devices. It has fixed thickness and wide width wires to improve the drive current and electrostatics behavior. Nanosheet FET has wider applications in the memory, analog and RF application. Recent research is in Nanosheet FET toIn this paper, the various Nanosheet FET device structures, its advantage and applications are discussed.

articleTitle: See Beyond the Spice: Detecting Black Pepper Adulteration with HSI and Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Emerging Trends in Information Technology and Engineering (ICETITE)
abstract: Pepper is a valuable medicinal substance and an expensive aromatic. For profit purposes, some vendors adulterate dried papaya seeds with black pepper due to their physical similarities. This impurity can lead to various health issues. Several existing methods are available to detect this adulteration, but they have some limitations. To overcome these challenges, the study employed a technique called Hyperspectral Imaging (HSI) by using machine learning classification algorithms. This research experimented with various machine learning classification algorithms, including Decision Tree, Random Forest, and Linear Discriminant Analysis (LDA). Among these algorithms, the Decision Tree algorithm stood out as the most effective in achieving an impressive classification accuracy of 99.93%, with a computational time of 6.76 seconds. This hyperspectral imaging analysis and the machine learning classification hold significant promise in enhancing food quality assurance, ensuring consumer health, and reinforcing trust within the industry.

articleTitle: Employee Attrition Analysis Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Emerging Trends in Information Technology and Engineering (ICETITE)
abstract: The production, morale and financial health of an organization can all be significantly impacted by staff attrition or the voluntary withdrawal of employees. An employee attrition study is a crucial step that enables organizations to identify the cause of the attrition and resolve the issue in order for them to grasp and successfully manage this challenge. In order to perform the research, extensive data on employee exits, job satisfaction, and other factors are initially acquired. Data preprocessing and cleaning ensure that the data are accurate and suitable for analysis. It is possible to identify patterns and trends in attrition using statistical analysis and data visualization tools, and discover how turnover is connected to factors like income, work-life balance, performance, and a variety of other factors. In this project, we experiment with numerous algorithms in order to determine which one would best match the model. We are able to comprehend the top most important factors after selecting the ideal algorithm. We will examine employee attrition across a number of businesses in this article to determine its causes, which will assist the organization understand and manage a challenging position and resolve the issue.

articleTitle: Ornamental Portable Battlefield Surveillance using Generative Adversarial Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Emerging Trends in Information Technology and Engineering (ICETITE)
abstract: This article investigates the sole use of generative adversarial networks (GANs) for portable battlefield surveillance equipment optimisation. High-resolution and clear pictures are produced by the strategic application of GANs for accurate object recognition, anomaly detection, and real-time video quality enhancement. In military applications, the resultant GAN-centric surveillance system exhibits increased accuracy and efficiency. We report major progress in object detection, anomalous activity detection, including video quality improvement. This GAN-centric approach significantly enhances situational awareness, allowing military personnel to make quick and accurate decisions in a variety of dynamic and varied operational settings. The study demonstrates how GANs may effectively advance military technology for surveillance on mobile platforms, strengthening national security standards in the process. The results highlight how GANs are uniquely adept in powerful improvements in military surveillance capabilities, which in turn improves their operational efficiency. In order to improve both the visual appeal and the efficacy of surveillance in a variety of military environments, this research paper suggests a novel way to improve portable battlefield surveillance systems through the integration of Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs). The technique emphasises discrete design and real-time processing capabilities for portable devices, with a focus on the creation and implementation of a GAN-based system.

articleTitle: Design and Characterization of a Flexible PET based Microstrip Patch Antenna with L Probe Feeding Technique
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Emerging Trends in Information Technology and Engineering (ICETITE)
abstract: A flexible microstrip patch antenna with additional slot is designed using Polyethylene terephthalate substrate. Designed antenna was simulated using the Ansys HFSS software at an operating frequency of 5.2 GHz. Obtained patterns are remarkably stable. The technique used in the antenna's construction helps to overcome the limitations of conventional L-probe fed antenna, such as dielectric constant variations and limited flexibility. The results obtained in terms of VSWR = 1.63, directivity = 7.72dB, gain =7.05 dBi, return loss = - 14.86 dB indicates the performance improvement than the conventional Rogers substrate antenna. Inverted T shaped flexible antenna is suitable for short range wireless communications.

articleTitle: Smart Aquaponics Oversight: IoT Sensors and Mobile App Empowered Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Emerging Trends in Information Technology and Engineering (ICETITE)
abstract: The primary objective of this study is to devise and execute an advanced monitoring framework tailored for sustaining the symbiotic ecosystem essential for both plant and fish cultivation. The system employs an array of sensors adept at detecting and quantifying pivotal environmental parameters, encompassing temperature, humidity, pH levels, dissolved oxygen, and nutrient concentrations. These sensor-derived data are subsequently subjected to processing and channeled to the Firebase cloud database. To render the amassed data easily accessible, a mobile application is under development employing Android Studio. This app instantaneously visualizes the ongoing sensor-acquired data, affording real-time insight into the ecosystem's condition. This functionality empowers cultivators and users to closely oversee the well-being of their plant and aquatic life, thereby facilitating judicious decision-making concerning harvesting and replanting timings. Furthermore, an eCommerce platform will be provisioned, serving as a conduit for farmers to engage in trade with consumers. This digital interface streamlines the purchase of fresh and wholesome produce for consumers, concurrently endowing farmers with an avenue to market their yield. The anticipated system is poised to furnish real-time data to cultivators, enhancing yield optimization. Empirical results validate the system's capacity to furnish precise and dependable data, poised for harnessing in crop and fish yield optimization. In effect, this promises augmented productivity, elevated product caliber, and heightened profitability for cultivators.

articleTitle: IoT in Agriculture 4.0: Farmer Adoption, Barriers, and the Path to Sustainable Farming
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Emerging Trends in Information Technology and Engineering (ICETITE)
abstract: With a history dating back to ancient civilizations, Indian agriculture has evolved through ages of different cultural practices, colonialism, and technological transformation and modernization. IoT in agriculture 4.0 refers to the integration of the Internet of Things with modern agricultural practices and methodology. This involves the transformation of traditional farming/agriculture into a more efficient, profitable, and, at the same time, sustainable and technologically advanced sector. This research paper looks into two very critical aspects of IoT in agriculture 4.0: farmer Adoption and Barriers, and the holistic impact of IoT on the agriculture ecosystem. Furthermore, this research paper explores the factors that affect the farmers' decisions in the adoption of the new-age technology and the holistic impact that IoT will have on environmental sustainability, biodiversity, soil health, and local communities.

articleTitle: Job Recommendation System using LinkedIn User Profiles
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Emerging Trends in Information Technology and Engineering (ICETITE)
abstract: One of the services that LinkedIn offers is a job recommendation system that helps users find job opportunities that match their interests and skills. This paper investigates the recommender system for LinkedIn user profiles to generate job recommendations, highlighting the key factors and approaches that influence the recommendation process and there is potential for bias in LinkedIn's job recommendation system. The content-based filtering approach involves using the attributes of the job posting and the user's profile to generate job recommendations. Collaborative filtering is an approach that uses the behaviour of other users to generate recommendations. This could involve introducing demographic data into the recommendation process or using more advanced machine learning techniques to eliminate bias. The findings can be used to inform future improvements to the job recommendation service, making it more effective for users and promoting more equitable hiring practices. By improving the job recommendation system, LinkedIn can provide greater value to its users and support the growth of professional networks and job opportunities.

articleTitle: Detection of fault in Railway track using Image processing and Fuzzy logic
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Emerging Trends in Information Technology and Engineering (ICETITE)
abstract: The transportation route is being impacted by the elaborate development of railway transportation vehicles. Many errors happen Due to the use of train lines. Both manufacturing mistakes and improper rail usage are to blame for these failures. There are numerous techniques for spotting errors early and fixing them. The camera-based approach is one of these techniques. By using the cameras mounted to the railway vehicle, pictures taken of the rail components are inspected. The components of the rail show faults are found. A technique for identifying and categorizing flaws on rail track surfaces is suggested in this paper. The suggested approach utilized image processing to identify the rail surface. High resolution photos taken by specialized cameras mounted on railway inspection cars are used in the proposed system. A variety of track issues, including fractures, weld flaws, track misalignment, and ballast degradation, are detected and analyzed using these photos. Pre-processing, feature extraction, and segmentation algorithms are used in the image processing procedures to isolate the track region and highlight any potential flaws. Fuzzy logic is used to rank maintenance tasks according to priority after defects have been found and their severity has been determined. Fuzzy logic is well suited for capturing the subjective judgements involved in evaluating track conditions because it offers a flexible framework for processing ambiguous and imprecise data. To assign the proper severity levels to the extracted features of each defect type, fuzzy rules and membership functions are constructed.

articleTitle: Analysis of Online Fake News Using Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Emerging Trends in Information Technology and Engineering (ICETITE)
abstract: Nowadays, the internet is the foremost source of sharing information, and most online media give information without validating the information, thus it misdirects the online media with no importance to the real world. So, it is very important for a specialist even in a specific article area needs to investigate the information from various angles prior to giving a choice on the genuineness of an article. This paper proposes the need to use different AI and ML methods, which incorporates singular student approach and outfit approach, for robotized order of news stories. In this paper, we investigate various textual properties that can be utilized to separate fake news from real. With the help of these properties, we trained the data's using different machine learning algorithms and computed their performance using real-world data set. In this undertaking, we will disclose a few different ways to recognize counterfeit news utilizing gathered information from various articles. Yet, similar methods can be applied to various scenarios. Accuracy is being checked for different calculations and some machine learning models are utilized to play out a classification task (fake or not).

articleTitle: Advanced Palm Detection Techniques in Forensic Science Using UVPVUP Technique
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Emerging Trends in Information Technology and Engineering (ICETITE)
abstract: In the framework of an engaging case study, vein pattern analysis proved to be an essential tool for a break-in investigation. The skilled crime scene investigators carefully studied the unique vein patterns seen on a broken window that the criminal had used to break into homes. Vein pattern analysis obtained accurate images of the veins under investigation using sophisticated near-infrared imaging techniques. After that, these photos were painstakingly compared to an extensive database that contained information on well-known people, including suspects and property owners. By closely comparing the burglar's vein patterns, knowledgeable forensic specialists could link them to the location of the crime. This specific case study clearly illustrates the exceptional effectiveness of vein pattern analysis as a potent forensic technique used to locate and identify people engaged in criminal activity with an accuracy of 71 percent.

articleTitle: Implementation of Multi-Pattern Search Using Motion Analyser for Motion Estimation
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Emerging Trends in Information Technology and Engineering (ICETITE)
abstract: Motion estimation is a computationally complex block in video compression. It accounts for 70% of the power consumption in video encoder. There are many challenges in the implementation of these Motion Estimation algorithms. Block-based techniques are extremely popular for Motion estimation. Fast-search motion estimation methods are widely used but the main challenge of these techniques is block-partitioning, similar to the partitioning scheme in High-Efficiency Video Coding (HEVC). In this paper, a multi-pattern search is implemented for motion estimation using a motion analyzer. Multi-pattern search for motion estimation is a sophisticated technique that significantly improves the efficiency and accuracy of motion prediction in video processing, particularly in scenarios where real-time processing and high compression are required.

articleTitle: Digitalize The System to Diagnosis of Neurological Disorder (Sleep Disorder)
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Emerging Trends in Information Technology and Engineering (ICETITE)
abstract: In this paper, the possessions and waveform of human EEG signals are investigated to make a digital system. The objective of this study is to provide a signal spectrum analysis of the changes in the area of various sleep phases. The observations made on the EEG patterns might be examined for their applicability in the identification of sleep disorders, including sadness and anxiety. By recording brain signals and pictures, it is possible to see changes in the electrical and chemical activity in the brain that are a reflection of these illnesses. The electroencephalogram (EEG) signals used in this study were subjected to a Short Time-Frequency Analysis of Power Spectrum Density (STFAPSD) technique for the purpose of diagnosing various types of sleep disorders, and a digital method for the diagnosis of neurological disorders was proposed

articleTitle: Early Skin Cancer Detection Using CNN-ABCD Rule Based Feature Extraction Classification and K-Means Clustering algorithm through Android Mobile Application
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Emerging Trends in Information Technology and Engineering (ICETITE)
abstract: Our proposed system focuses on the development of a skin cancer prediction model using machine learning algorithms. Skin cancer is the most common cancer disease in almost all the country. Current estimates are more than a million cases are witnessing skin cancer in their lifetime. As per the statistics, the north region of India stands first with 100,000 skin for both males and females with 1.62lakhs and 1.21lakhs, respectively. This proposed system's aim is to create an accurate and efficient diagnostic mobile application to classify skin cancer based on a dataset of skin lesion images obtained from the Kaggle data source. Advanced machine learning techniques such as ABCD Feature rule is employed in the proposed model to achieve high predictive accuracy, and the model outcome will undergo comprehensive performance analysis, evaluating metrics such as sensitivity, specificity and accuracy. The significance is underscored by the growing global incidence of skin cancer, as early detection is crucial for improving patient outcomes. The versatile tool such as an android mobile application generated by the proposed model can be deployed in diverse clinical settings, aiding dermatologists and medical professionals in making timely and informed decisions for accurate diagnosis and effective treatment plans. The research methodology is based on qualitative analysis where various kinds of literature are being reviewed based on machine learning.

Author Keywords: Android Mobile Application for Skin Cancer Detection

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of IoT-based Monitoring System for Multi Infusion Liquid Level
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Emerging Trends in Information Technology and Engineering (ICETITE)
abstract: Basically the kind of internet of things (IoT) in healthcare and medical sector can take many forms such as smart health services and medical devices. This paper deals with the design and implementation of IoT-based medical device in a form of system for monitoring multi infusion liquid level. The proposed device is designed to provide ease in the healthcare industry, particularly for hospital patients and medical staff. The monitoring system is intended to read indicators from the sensors mounted on the object, including infusion volume indicators and infusion drop indicators. This device transforms the voltage value from the load cell sensor to the infusion volume. When wholly charged in a 500 ml infusion, the load cell sensor voltage is 4.9 V, which lowers as the infusion volume declines. This figure is subsequently transmitted under control via a web service that can be viewed from a smartphone or personal computer (PC), allowing nurses to determine the amount of infusion in the patient.

articleTitle: Route Optimization Using Clustering and K Opt Optimization for Garbage Collection
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Emerging Trends in Information Technology and Engineering (ICETITE)
abstract: In today's rapidly developing world, emerging technologies are revolutionizing all aspects of life. One important aspect is that of development of Smart Cities.With this concept all domains of a society need to be improved upon. One of the important domains is that of waste management systems.Right from collection of garbage from within the society, to disposing of the waste in an environment friendly and all the steps in between need to carried out in an efficient manner.A major challenge in this process is that of deciding upon a route for garbage collection which can provide the most optimum result in terms of time taken to complete the process, distance travelled by each vehicle, whilst considering different factors such as traffic congestion, capacity of each truck and few others.

articleTitle: Sentiment Analysis on Reddit Trading Data
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Emerging Trends in Information Technology and Engineering (ICETITE)
abstract: In the volatile world of trading, success frequently depends on the ability to devise and implement effective methods. Understanding market sentiment has been increasingly important for stabilizing revenue and separating strategic trading from simply speculation since the advent of internet trading forums such as those on Reddit. This research offers a novel machine learning model that uses sentiment analysis to evaluate Reddit trading data, with the goal of providing traders with a better-informed decision-making base. This model tries to decipher the frequently complicated and trend-driven conversation within trading groups by merging techniques from machine learning, deep learning, and mathematical transformations–including VADER Analysis and Fourier Transforms, complemented by Long-Short Term Memory networks. The idea is to turn what often appears to be gambling into a more systematic approach to trading led by data-driven insights into market emotion.

articleTitle: An Impactful and Revolutionized Educational Ecosystem using Generative AI to Assist and Assess the Teaching and Learning benefits, Fostering the Post-Pandemic Requirements
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Emerging Trends in Information Technology and Engineering (ICETITE)
abstract: Artificial Intelligence (AI) has the potential to revolutionize various aspects of education due to its rapid expansion in educational technology by introducing personalized and efficient learning experiences. Several artificial intelligence (AI) tools are being integrated into this research project such as “Coursera Coach powered by Generative AI” which incorporates adaptive learning, “AI- assisted course building powered by Generative AI” which incorporates intelligent tutoring elements and “Turnitin” offers tools for grading and providing feedback to revolutionize teaching, learning, and assessment practices in higher education. Researchers evaluate the effectiveness of AI tools in enhancing student engagement, personalizing learning experiences, and optimizing assessment processes based on a variety of quantitative metrics. A comparison is made between experimental groups that follow AI-integrated teaching methods and control groups that follow a traditional approach to instruction. As part of the study, scores of pre- and post-assessment questions were collected, learning progression patterns were analyzed, and instructors and students provided qualitative feedback. As a result of the experimental data, it has been possible to discern which AI tools have strengths and limitations within the context of higher education. A variety of adaptive learning platforms are evaluated for their ability to adjust content to individual learning styles, while intelligent tutoring systems are assessed for their impact on comprehension, retention, and problem-solving skills. Automated grading tools are tested for their efficiency gains in assessment processes and their ability to improve feedback promptness and quality. A substantial amount of empirical evidence is provided by the findings of this study to the ongoing discourse on AI integration in higher education. This study provides a wealth of actionable insights for academic staff, technicians, and administrators seeking evidence-based strategies for implementing AI technologies in their educational frameworks.

articleTitle: A Survey on Optimizing Virtualized Service Management in Mobile Edge Cloud Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Emerging Trends in Information Technology and Engineering (ICETITE)
abstract: Mobile Edge Computing (MEC) and Network Function Virtualization (NFV) have emerged as viable solutions for meeting the growing need in mobile networks for low-latency, high-bandwidth, and efficient data processing. MEC puts processing and storage capabilities much nearer to the networks edge, enabling mobile users to utilize low-latency and high- bandwidth services. Whereas, Network function virtualization (NFV) allowing them to be put on general-purpose servers rather than dedicated hardware. However, due to the constant change of the environment and the different needs of mobile users, the management and efficient operation of virtualized services in MEC networks offers major hurdles. This literature review is intended to provide a complete overview of MEC and NFV research and progress. It then examines MEC's integration with NFV, highlighting the synergies and advantages it offers. Benefits of this integration include improved resource utilization, enhanced scalability, and flexibility in program configuration. Issues related to the deployment and management of MEC and NFV such as resource allocation, security and power consumption are also discussed.

articleTitle: Unveiling Fake News with Machine Learning and Natural Language Processing Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Emerging Trends in Information Technology and Engineering (ICETITE)
abstract: The detection of fake news using machine learning and natural language processing techniques. With the proliferation of misinformation on social media and digital platforms, identifying fake news has become crucial. The project preprocesses textual data, applies various machine learning models, including logistic regression, Naïve Bayes, decision trees, random forest, neural networks, support vector machines, and AdaBoost Classifier, and employs dimensionality reduction techniques like PCA and t-SNE. The dataset is categorized into cases with and without speaker and political party information, and label encoding is used for numeric conversion. The results highlight the challenges and complexities of fake news detection.

articleTitle: Design and Performance Evaluation of an Interior Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor for an Electric Three-Wheeler
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Emerging Trends in Information Technology and Engineering (ICETITE)
abstract: This paper unequivocally presents the meticulous design and comprehensive evaluation of a 5-kW interior permanent magnet synchronous motor for the application of an electric three-wheeler. The configuration investigated for this study is 36 stator slots and 6 rotor poles with a three-phase IPM with a lateral magnet rotor motor. Initially, the motor rating is estimated using a dynamic computation of the vehicle. For the obtained rating, the other main dimension is calculated analytically. For validation, performance analysis for acquired specs is performed using finite element-based software. The impact of stator and rotor parameter variance, as well as core material analysis, are then investigated utilizing various material thicknesses. The results revealed that variation in magnet thickness has a substantial effect on performance metrics, and the material study revealed that M700-50A is more efficient than other materials. Furthermore, to investigate the positive aspects of permanent magnets, many PM materials were investigated, and it was found that NdFeB magnets delivered the desired output. From the aforementioned analysis, the optimal design is derived, and its outcomes exhibit that it has a higher average torque, less torque, and is more efficient. As a result, it was determined that IPM with a lateral magnet design satisfied the vehicle's criteria and proved it to be a suitable design for an electric three-wheeler.

articleTitle: Monetary Loan Eligibility Prediction using Logistic Regression Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Emerging Trends in Information Technology and Engineering (ICETITE)
abstract: In the banking sector, predicting customer loan eligibility is a crucial task. This paper presents a study of using machine learning algorithms to predict loan eligibility of customers based on credit history, income, and others. The algorithms used in the study are Logistic Regression. Using machine learning algorithms the results are demonstrated the potential of in the banking sector to improve loan decision-making processes and increase efficiency. The study utilized a dataset containing information on various loan applications and their respective approvals. The dataset was pre-processed and various machine learning algorithms were applied to the data to determine the best model for predicting loan approval. The findings of this study can be useful for financial institutions in making informed decisions about loan approvals, reducing the risk of default and improving the overall loan approval process. The model is trained using a dataset containing various demographic and financial parameters of loan applicants. The Logistic regression algorithm is utilized to build a predictive model that determines the eligibility of a loan applicant based on the input features. The system aims to modernize the loan approval process by using predictive algorithms to analyze and evaluate loan applications. The study compares different machine learning algorithms, including logistic regression and support vector machines, and evaluates their performance in terms of accuracy and efficiency. The findings also suggest that the use of machine learning can help banks streamline their loan approval processes.

articleTitle: Emergency Vehicle Detection Using Deep ConvNet2D and Computer Vision
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Emerging Trends in Information Technology and Engineering (ICETITE)
abstract: A surveillance system detects emergency vehicles stuck in traffic. This system helps manage traffic because the number of vehicles on the road has been increasing daily for years, causing congestion. This project implements Deep ConvNet2D (Convolutional Network 2D) and Computer Vision emergency vehicle recognition. We propose a CNN-based real-time image processing model for emergency vehicle detection. The signal control unit can be set to terminate the round robin sequence when an emergency vehicle is detected. A CNN trained on Indian ambulance images solves the problem. Tensor Flow, a Python library, was used for training. Our method detects and classifies emergency cars well. Existing systems use ANN algorithm, which is inaccurate and inefficient. The system uses Deep ConvNet2D Algorithm. The proposed real-time system is accurate. The proposed system loads and executes faster than the existing system. The system is efficient, scalable, and enhanced for complex use cases.

articleTitle: Comparative Study of Disease Prediction Through Data Mining
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Emerging Trends in Information Technology and Engineering (ICETITE)
abstract: The growing occurrence of persistent liver disorder has been cited in current times. Similarly Diabetes, one of the frequently spreading disease is growing hastily in all of the Nations nowadays. According to WHO, approximately 422 million humans globally have diabetes and 1.5 million deaths are without delay associated with diabetes disorder. So the effective analysis should be made to detect the presence of disease before it kills the patient which reflects a plenty of studies have been made in the field of healthcare. In this paper, we are going to predict these two diseases through one of the data mining techniques called classification. The analysis is completed using Jupyter Notebook. One of the data mining techniques called supervised learning or the classification is applied in which we have used Decision tree, Logistic Regression, Random Forest, K-Nearest Neighbor. The data in this research paper is taken from University of California Irvine repository of machine learning. The main aim of this paper is to provide brief prediction on both diabetes and liver disease and the goal is to provide a better final results when compared to the other algorithms, for the disease prediction. In results we are predicting the presence of diabetes disease with 98% of accuracy with Random forest algorithm and prediction of liver disorder has 81.59% of accuracy with Random Forest algorithm along with accuracy we have attempted to use some parameters like precision, recall, F-Measure for the evaluation.

articleTitle: Development of L-Band FMCW Radar on SDR using GNU RADIO
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Emerging Trends in Information Technology and Engineering (ICETITE)
abstract: Ground Penetrating Radar (GPR) is a versatile technology widely employed for subsurface imaging and non-destructive testing in various applications. This research presents the design and implementation of a Frequency-Modulated Continuous-Wave (FMCW) L-Band Radar using Software-Defined Radio (SDR) and the GNU Radio framework. The proposed radar system operates within the L-Band frequency range, offering improved penetration depth and resolution for accurate subsurface mapping. Leveraging SDR with GNU Radio allows for the realtime adaptability of the radar parameters, enabling customized waveform generation and agile signal processing techniques. The hardware design encompasses the selection and optimization of L- Band RF components, including antennas, mixers, and power amplifiers, to meet the specific radar requirements. GNU Radio serves as a flexible platform for integrating and controlling the SDR transceiver, ensuring seamless communication between the software and hardware components. The research focuses on implementing advanced signal processing algorithms, such as fast Fourier transforms (FFT), to enhance the radar's target detection capabilities and imaging resolution. Moreover, the software-defined nature of the system allows for multi-channel operation and synchronized data acquisition, enabling coherent processing for increased detection sensitivity. Experiments are conducted to evaluate the performance of the FMCW L-Band radar in various subsurface environments. Results demonstrate the radar's effectiveness in detecting and imaging subsurface objects and structures with high accuracy and resolution. The proposed design presents a cost-effective and versatile solution, empowering researchers and practitioners with an open-source radar platform for customizing and optimizing radar parameters to specific applications. Additionally, the integration of GNU Radio and SDR in the FMCW L-Band radar holds great potential for advancing the state-of-the-art in GPR.

articleTitle: Design and Development of FPGA Based Acoustic Signal Measurement System for Space Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Emerging Trends in Information Technology and Engineering (ICETITE)
abstract: On orbit acoustic measurement provides precise parameters to structure designers for space system design. The paper presents Octave band filter based acoustic measurement solution for space applications. Any flight system has major constraints in handling radiation, extreme temperatures and therefore realized using space qualified components. Paper deals with implementation of FPGA based acoustic signal processing. Design, implementation, and testing aspects of the realized system are investigated. Different techniques to implement simultaneous measurement of more than one channel and configurability aspects of the developed system are discussed. Real time testing is carried out by realizing the system on Microsemi FPGA platform. Cut-off frequency of developed filter for each octave band is compared with therotical value.

articleTitle: Analysis and Modification of Fault Detection Methods in Photovoltaic Array
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Emerging Trends in Information Technology and Engineering (ICETITE)
abstract: The reliability of the larger photovoltaic (PV) systems is very vulnerable with respect to faults. The faults may transpire in dc/ac side PV system. The detection, classification and location identification of faults are very important to mitigate the energy loss, accidents, etc. It is also required to ensure the periodic revenue generation. In this paper, different faults have been simulated and datasets are collected from it for normal and faulty conditions. From the collected datasets, relevant features were extracted and then fed into a Machine Learning (ML) algorithm. To predict and classify faults with new data, the ML model was trained with historical data. The condition of partial shading in PV arrays is also addressed and a progressive, evolutionary Maximum Power Point Tracking (MPPT) method is employed to combat it. In this work, ML algorithms are carried out for fault analysis of PV array. The developed ML algorithm is tested with few practical datasets.

articleTitle: Market Basket Analysis for Retail Sales Optimization
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Emerging Trends in Information Technology and Engineering (ICETITE)
abstract: Supermarkets and grocery stores aim to improve customer experience and maximize sales. Recommending frequently bought items and optimizing the layout of products can enhance customer satisfaction and sales revenue. The proposed system “Market basket analysis for retail sales optimization” introduces a data-driven solution that leverages association rule mining algorithms, namely Eclat, FP-growth, and Apriori to recommend frequently purchased grocery items and optimize their placement within the store layout. The paper starts by utilizing a rich dataset of daily purchased grocery items, including historical transaction data. By employing the algorithms, the system uncovers hidden patterns, associations, and correlations among the purchased items. These algorithms efficiently mine frequent itemsets, allowing the system to recommend items that are often bought together. In addition to personalized recommendations, the project optimizes the store layout. Items that are frequently purchased together are strategically positioned in proximity to enhance customer convenience and encourage additional purchases. Simultaneously, it helps store owners to maximize sales by strategically placing items based on their association with one another. This paper bridges the gap between data analytics and retail optimization, offering a solution that benefits both customers and store operators.

articleTitle: SoK: A Holistic View of Cyberattacks Prediction with Digital Twins
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Emerging Trends in Information Technology and Engineering (ICETITE)
abstract: Digital Twins (DTs) are a relatively new technology that has the potential to transform entire fields such as construction, health, and every field one can imagine, including cybersecurity. DTs represent a cutting-edge solution to mitigate cyber risks as they can accurately emulate hardware, software, and firmware. By collecting and providing data, they allow realtime monitoring, analysis, and emulation. This paper digs into the current practices followed to predict cyberattacks, it then explores the fundamental principles of digital twins and their current common uses in the industry. Finally, it examines how digital twins can be employed to enhance the organisation's overall cybersecurity maturity level.

articleTitle: Smart Car Parking System
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Emerging Trends in Information Technology and Engineering (ICETITE)
abstract: Land transportation in India heavily relies on railway stations, yet these stations face issues with parking due to manual methods, resulting in congestion and inefficiencies. Current approaches also face difficulties such as inadequate real-time parking allocation, a deficiency in digital payment options, and issues related to user-friendliness. To address this, a cutting-edge solution is proposed which harnesses advanced technologies like image processing, Raspberry Pi, OCR for license plate recognition, and cashless transactions. Ultrasonic sensor verifys vehicle presence, OCR deciphers license plates, and historical data manages parking logistics, slot detection is done using Pickle. Travelers can conveniently access parking fees on an OLED screen, receive a QR code for exiting, simplifying payments and improving safety. The project places a strong emphasis on environmental sustainability and real-time updates. It is designed with potential for expansion and integration with other station services, offering an effective, eco-conscious parking system that can adapt to evolving transportation needs.

articleTitle: Stock Price Prediction of IT Midcaps Companies Using ML Models
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Emerging Trends in Information Technology and Engineering (ICETITE)
abstract: This research investigates the influence of past quarterly results data on the share price movements of Indian IT midcap companies. Leveraging a dataset comprising quarterly financial reports of ten prominent midcap companies, this study employs a multi-faceted approach to stock price prediction. The dataset was obtained from trusted sources in the financial data domain, ensuring the reliability and comprehensiveness of the data. First, we explore the correlation between various financial parameters found within the quarterly reports. Our findings reveal noteworthy associations, highlighting the impact of key financial metrics such as Operating Profit Margin (OPM %), Expenses, Interest, Depreciation, and Tax Percentage on overall financial performance. Next, employing multiple linear regression, we assess the predictive power of these metrics on stock prices. Our analysis uncovers valuable insights, indicating that variables such as Market Cap, Price-to-Earnings (P/E) ratio, Face Value, Net Profit and Earnings Per Share (EPS) significantly affect share prices. Nevertheless, several other metrics, including Sales, Expenses, and Operating Profit, do not exhibit statistically significant relationships with stock prices. Subsequently, we employ Multiple Linear Regression and Random Forest models to predict stock prices based on past quarterly results data. Our predictions vary in accuracy across the selected companies Discrepancies in predictive performance underscore the importance of feature selection, data quality, and market dynamics in refining our predictive models.

articleTitle: Ensemble Regression Machine Learning Based Detection of Intrusion Packets in Healthcare Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Emerging Trends in Information Technology and Engineering (ICETITE)
abstract: Wireless sensor networks (WSNs) have arisen as a feasible technology in healthcare applications, due to recent developments in wireless networking, wireless sensors, and low-power systems with networks. Securing these networks is essential for practical deployment in healthcare applications since the data transferred in these wireless body area networks (WBAN) frequently consists of sensitive and important patient health and personal information. The objective of this study is to create and develop sophisticated intrusion detection methods that will increase protection in WBAN. In this study, we offer an intrusion detection system (IDS) that utilises Ens_learnHealth to offer the best identification of attacks for such environments. The suggested approach ensures that the intrusion detection process uses exactly the features required for identifying a particular attack, reducing the difficulty of computation. As a result, it is found that Ens_learnHealth achieves 99.7% of accuracy, 98.4% of precision, 95% of recall,96% of F1-score, and 21% of miss rate.

articleTitle: NeuroCluster: Neural Networks for Intelligent Energy-Aware Clustering in IIoT
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Emerging Trends in Information Technology and Engineering (ICETITE)
abstract: The advent of Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT) has ushered in a new era of connectivity, providing unprece-dented insights and control over industrial processes. However, the energy efficiency of IIoT networks remains a critical concern, particularly in clustered environments. This paper introduces “NeuroCluster,” a pioneering approach leveraging neural networks for intelligent and energy-aware clustering in IIoT networks. NeuroCluster harnesses the power of neural networks to dynamically adapt clustering strategies based on realtime energy consumption patterns and environmental fac-tors. By incorporating learning mechanisms, the proposed system intelligently allocates devices into clusters, considering their current energy states and predictive models of future energy demands. This adaptive clustering not only optimizes energy usage but also extends the overall network lifetime. The neural network architecture employed by NeuroCluster is designed to capture intricate relationships between device characteristics, contextual variables, and energy consumption profiles. Training the neural network involves learning from historical data and continuous updates, enabling the system to evolve and adapt to changing industrial environments. To validate the effectiveness of NeuroCluster, extensive simulations were conducted using representative IIoT scenarios. Results demonstrate significant improvements in energy efficiency, showcasing the ability of the system to outperform traditional clustering methods. Further-more, NeuroCluster exhibits robustness in diverse operational conditions, making it a scalable and adaptable solution for a wide range of IIoT applications.

articleTitle: A Digital Forensic Analysis of Profiling and Avoidance of Websites Disseminating Disinformation
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Emerging Trends in Information Technology and Engineering (ICETITE)
abstract: The internet is an essential source of data for individuals across the world. However, disinformation has emerged as a significant problem due to its rapid growth on social media and the prevalence of fallacious news. Conventional strategies for detecting disinformation sites, like manual examination, are tedious and time-wasting. As a result, it is necessary to develop an effective method to find such websites. The goal of this research is to find websites that spread false information and prevent its further spread. The methodology is unique and effective for detecting disinformation websites as it makes use of the OSINT tool Maltego and focuses on websites that spread news having a negative impact such as in politics, health, finance, etc. Thus, the outcome of this research helps users to detect the authenticity of news in an easy and user-friendly manner by footprinting mechanisms.

articleTitle: Prediction of Cardiovascular Disease based on Lipid Profiles
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Emerging Trends in Information Technology and Engineering (ICETITE)
abstract: Cardiovascular disease (CVD) remains a global health concern, necessitating continuous efforts to develop predictive models for early risk assessment and intervention. This research employs machine learning and deep learning techniques to compare and predict CVD based on lipid profiles and extends its focus to estimate the future risk of CVD within the studied population. The study encompasses an array of features, including LDL, HDL, total cholesterol, triglycerides, and additional factors like age, BMI, blood glucose, and blood pressure. This study aims to compare the predictive performance of distinct models, logistic regression, SVM and neural networks in assessing the risk of CVD. The initial model, using logistic regression, neural networks and SVM classifier, achieved an accuracy of 85%, 88% and 87% respectively. Furthermore, a second model, designed for future likelihood prediction, demonstrated an accuracy of approximately 83% for logistic regression, 84% for neural networks and 85% for SVM classifier. The future risk of CVD is projected at 65.71%, with a 34.29% likelihood of no future CVD. Additionally, the research classifies CVD risk into four distinct categories, namely atherosclerosis, hyperlipidemia, hypoalphalipoproteinemia, offering valuable insights for tailored prevention and intervention strategies. This work contributes to the ongoing efforts to combat CVD by enhancing predictive accuracy and providing nuanced risk categorization.

articleTitle: Beyond Traditional Boundaries: A Survey of Security Mechanisms in Software-Defined Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Emerging Trends in Information Technology and Engineering (ICETITE)
abstract: The advent of Software-Defined Networking has revolutionized network management by decoupling the control and data planes, catering to diverse network requirements across various domains. SDNs may seem more secure than traditional networks, but they still have weaknesses and challenges in deployment. Due to its inherent flexibility and centralized control, this model change poses a risk to network integrity, confidentiality, and other security factors by introducing new vulnerabilities like packet spoofing and unauthorized access. In order to address some of the most significant security challenges with SDN implementations, we presented a thorough analysis in this paper that examined the risk associated with different SDN planes and APIs. A systematic review of the literature was carried out in order to explain the problem of potential attack situations and weaknesses. The various security suggestions that have been proposed or implemented for SDN are examined as well in this study. We also identify important research gaps based on the review of previous work that may facilitate further studies in this field.

articleTitle: Review on Security Concerns in Blockchain and it's Counter Measures
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Emerging Trends in Information Technology and Engineering (ICETITE)
abstract: Blockchain technology has gained significant attention across various industries due to its potential to revolutionize traditional processes by providing decentralized, immutable, and transparent data management. However, the widespread adoption of blockchain also brings forth an array of security challenges that must be effectively addressed to ensure its integrity and reliability. This paper delves into the multifaceted security issues that afflict blockchain ecosystems, encompassing smart contract vulnerabilities, consensus protocol attacks, privacy concerns, and scalability limitations. To tackle these problems and make blockchain safe to use, people are coming up with different solutions. They're using complex math techniques like cryptography to protect data and improve how the blockchain agrees on things. They're also developing better ways to write code for smart contracts so they're less likely to have problems. And they're making changes to the way the blockchain network itself is set up to make it more secure. It's a group effort involving researchers, developers, and policymakers to make sure blockchain reaches its full potential while staying safe and reliable. To mitigate these challenges, a comprehensive set of countermeasures is explored, ranging from cryptographic techniques and consensus algorithm enhancements to secure coding practices and network architecture improvements. Through collaborative efforts from researchers, developers, and policymakers, it is possible to unlock the full potential of blockchain while maintaining a robust and secure ecosystem.

articleTitle: Towards Safer Social Spaces: LSTM, Bi-LSTM and Hybrid Approach for Cyberbullying Detection in Assamese language on Social Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 Second International Conference on Emerging Trends in Information Technology and Engineering (ICETITE)
abstract: Social media provides a forum for constructive discussion while also providing an environment that is conducive to cyberbullying. Cyberstalking is a growing problem, especially on social media sites like Facebook. It is defined as harassment that occurs online without any physical contact. To mitigate its negative effects, automated procedures for locating and removing cyberbullying content must be put in place. The intent of this research is to broaden the scope of cyberbullying detection, with an emphasis on Assamese. Due to the limited digital resources, Assamese has not received much consideration in previous research.
